title: puttu
instructions: Step 1: Heat 1 cup water in a pan on medium flame for 3 minutes until warm but not boiling. Add 1 tsp salt and slowly sprinkle the warm water over 2 cup rice flour in a large bowl while mixing with fingers for 5 minutes until the flour becomes moist and crumbly without forming dough. Step 2: Rest the moistened flour for 10 minutes at room temperature so the moisture spreads evenly. Step 3: Fill the bottom chamber of a puttu steamer with 2 cup water and heat on high flame for 5 minutes until steam starts forming. Step 4: Add 2 tbsp coconut into the puttu maker tube, then add 1 cup prepared flour, followed by 2 tbsp coconut, then remaining flour and remaining coconut in layers. Step 5: Steam the puttu on medium flame for 8 minutes until strong steam releases from the top and the puttu smells cooked. Step 6: Remove the tube carefully, rest for 2 minutes, then push the puttu gently onto a plate and serve hot.

title: appam
instructions: Step 1: Wash 2 cup raw rice in water 3 times and soak it in 4 cup water for 4 hours at room temperature. Step 2: Drain the soaked rice and grind it in a mixer with 1 cup cooked rice, 1 cup coconut, 2 tsp sugar, and 2 cup water on medium speed for 8 minutes until a smooth batter forms. Step 3: Dissolve 1 tsp yeast in 1/4 cup lukewarm water and rest for 10 minutes until frothy. Step 4: Add the yeast mixture and 1 tsp salt into the batter and mix for 2 minutes using a spoon until evenly combined. Step 5: Cover the batter and ferment for 8 hours at room temperature until the batter becomes airy and slightly risen. Step 6: Heat an appam pan on medium flame for 2 minutes until hot. Pour 1 ladle batter into the center, rotate the pan immediately to spread thin edges, cover with lid, and cook on low flame for 3 minutes until edges turn light golden and the center becomes soft and cooked. Step 7: Remove the appam gently using a spatula and repeat with remaining batter.

title: vegetable fried rice
instructions: Step 1: Wash 2 cup basmati rice in water 3 times until water runs mostly clear.Step 2: Boil 5 cup water in a large pot on high flame for 5 minutes.Add 1 tsp salt and the rice,then cook on medium flame for 8 minutes until rice is just cooked and separate.Drain the rice and cool for 15 minutes on a plate.Step 3: Heat 3 tbsp oil in a wok on high flame for 2 minutes until hot.Add 1 tbsp garlic and stir fry for 30 seconds until aromatic.Step 4: Add 1 cup carrot,1 cup beans,and 1 cup cabbage.Stir fry on high flame for 5 minutes until vegetables become slightly soft but still crunchy.Step 5: Add the cooled rice,2 tbsp soy sauce,1 tsp black pepper,and remaining 1 tsp salt.Toss continuously on high flame for 4 minutes until rice is evenly coated and heated fully.Step 6: Add 1 cup spring onion and stir fry for 1 minute until fresh aroma develops.Step 7: Serve immediately while hot.

title: palada payasam

title: idiyappam
instructions: Step 1: Boil 2 cup water in a saucepan on high flame for 5 minutes until rapidly boiling.Add 1 tsp salt and 1 tbsp coconut oil into the water and stir for 30 seconds.Step 2: Add 2 cup rice flour into a large bowl and slowly pour the hot water while mixing with a wooden spoon for 3 minutes until a soft dough forms.Step 3: Rest the dough for 5 minutes until warm enough to handle.Knead for 4 minutes until smooth and soft without cracks.Step 4: Grease idiyappam mould lightly with a few drops of coconut oil.Fill the mould with dough.Step 5: Press the dough in circular motion onto idli plates to form thin noodle nests.Step 6: Heat 3 cup water in a steamer on high flame for 5 minutes until steam forms.Place the idli plates inside and steam on medium flame for 10 minutes until the idiyappam becomes firm and fully cooked.Step 7: Rest for 2 minutes before gently removing the idiyappam from the plates and serving hot.

title: pork vindaloo

instructions: Step 1: Wash 500 g cauliflower and cut into medium florets.Boil 4 cup water on high flame for 5 minutes.Add cauliflower and cook for 3 minutes until slightly tender.Drain completely and cool for 5 minutes.Step 2: Mix 1 cup maida,1/2 cup corn flour,1 tsp salt,and 1 cup water into a smooth thick batter.Step 3: Heat 500 ml oil in a deep kadai on medium flame for 8 minutes until hot.Dip cauliflower florets into the batter and fry in batches for 5 minutes until golden brown and crisp.Drain excess oil.Step 4: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a wok on high flame for 1 minute.Add 1 tbsp ginger,1 tbsp garlic,and 2 green chilli.Stir fry for 30 seconds until aromatic.Step 5: Add 1 cup onion and 1 cup capsicum.Stir fry on high flame for 3 minutes until slightly soft.Step 6: Add 2 tbsp soy sauce,2 tbsp tomato sauce,1 tbsp chilli sauce,remaining salt,and 1/2 cup water.Cook on medium flame for 2 minutes until sauce thickens slightly.Step 7: Add fried cauliflower and toss on high flame for 2 minutes until evenly coated with sauce.Step 8: Serve immediately while hot and crisp.

title: kappa biryani
ingredients: tapioca,beef,onion,green chilli,ginger,garlic,curry leaves,coconut oil,chilli powder,coriander powder,turmeric powder,black pepper,garam masala,salt,water
ingredient_measurements: [{"ingredient":"tapioca","measurement":"1 kg","quantity":"","unit":"","note":""},{"ingredient":"beef","measurement":"750 g","quantity":"","unit":"","note":""},{"ingredient":"onion","measurement":"2 cup","quantity":"","unit":"","note":""},{"ingredient":"green chilli","measurement":"3 number","quantity":"","unit":"","note":""},{"ingredient":"ginger","measurement":"2 tbsp","quantity":"","unit":"","note":""},{"ingredient":"garlic","measurement":"2 tbsp","quantity":"","unit":"","note":""},{"ingredient":"curry leaves","measurement":"3 tbsp","quantity":"","unit":"","note":""},{"ingredient":"coconut oil","measurement":"4 tbsp","quantity":"","unit":"","note":""},{"ingredient":"chilli powder","measurement":"2 tbsp","quantity":"","unit":"","note":""},{"ingredient":"coriander powder","measurement":"2 tbsp","quantity":"","unit":"","note":""},{"ingredient":"turmeric powder","measurement":"1 tsp","quantity":"","unit":"","note":""},{"ingredient":"black pepper","measurement":"2 tsp","quantity":"","unit":"","note":""},{"ingredient":"garam masala","measurement":"1 tsp","quantity":"","unit":"","note":""},{"ingredient":"salt","measurement":"3 tsp","quantity":"","unit":"","note":""},{"ingredient":"water","measurement":"5 cup","quantity":"","unit":"","note":""}]
instructions: Step 1: Wash 1 kg tapioca thoroughly,peel the skin,and cut into medium cubes.Wash the cubes in water 2 times to remove excess starch.Step 2: Add tapioca into a large pot with 4 cup water and 1 tsp salt.Boil on high flame for 5 minutes,drain the water completely,then add fresh 4 cup water and cook on medium flame for 20 minutes until soft.Drain fully and mash lightly.Step 3: Wash 750 g beef thoroughly and add into a pressure cooker with 1 tbsp ginger,1 tbsp garlic,1 tbsp chilli powder,1 tbsp coriander powder,1/2 tsp turmeric powder,1 tsp salt,and 1 cup water.Pressure cook on high flame for 1 whistle and then on low flame for 25 minutes until tender.Step 4: Heat 4 tbsp coconut oil in a heavy pan on medium flame for 2 minutes.Add 2 cup onion,3 green chilli,remaining ginger,remaining garlic,and 2 tbsp curry leaves.Saute for 10 minutes until onions turn deep golden brown.Step 5: Add remaining chilli powder,coriander powder,turmeric powder,black pepper,garam masala,and remaining salt.Roast on low flame for 2 minutes until aromatic.Step 6: Add cooked beef and cook uncovered on medium flame for 10 minutes until masala thickens and coats the beef.Step 7: Add mashed tapioca and mix thoroughly on low flame for 5 minutes until evenly combined.Step 8: Garnish with remaining curry leaves and rest for 5 minutes before serving hot.

instructions: Step 1: Wash 2 cup basmati rice in water 3 times and soak in 3 cup water for 20 minutes.Drain completely.Step 2: Heat 3 tbsp oil in a heavy pot on medium flame for 2 minutes.Add 1 tsp mustard seeds and cook for 30 seconds until crackling.Step 3: Add 1 cup onion,2 green chilli,1 tbsp ginger,1 tbsp garlic,and 1 tbsp curry leaves.Saute for 5 minutes until onions soften.Step 4: Add 3 cup tomato and cook on medium flame for 8 minutes until tomatoes become soft and oil separates.Step 5: Add 1 tsp chilli powder,1/2 tsp turmeric powder,and 2 tsp salt.Roast on low flame for 2 minutes until raw smell disappears.Step 6: Add drained rice and stir gently on medium flame for 2 minutes until coated with masala.Step 7: Add 4 cup hot water and bring to boil on high flame for 5 minutes.Step 8: Cover and cook on low flame for 15 minutes until rice becomes soft and water fully absorbs.Step 9: Rest for 10 minutes before fluffing gently and serving.

title: chicken shawarma
instructions: Step 1: Wash 750 g chicken thoroughly and cut into thin strips.Combine chicken with 1 cup yogurt,1 tbsp garlic,1 tsp black pepper,1 tsp chilli powder,1 tsp cumin powder,1 tbsp oil,and 1 tsp salt.Mix well and marinate for 1 hour in a covered bowl inside a cool place.Step 2: Mix 3 cup maida,1 tsp yeast,1 tsp sugar,1/2 tsp salt,1 tbsp oil,and 1 cup lukewarm water.Knead for 8 minutes until soft dough forms.Rest covered for 1 hour until doubled in size.Step 3: Divide dough into equal balls.Roll each ball into thin circles and cook on a hot tawa on medium flame for 2 minutes on each side until light brown spots appear.Step 4: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a pan on medium flame for 2 minutes.Add marinated chicken and cook for 12 minutes while stirring until chicken becomes fully cooked and lightly charred.Step 5: Mix 1 cup cabbage,1 cup onion,and 1 cup tomato in a bowl.Step 6: Spread 2 tbsp mayonnaise over each bread.Place vegetable mixture and cooked chicken in the center.Roll tightly and toast on a tawa for 2 minutes until slightly crisp.Step 7: Cut and serve hot.

instructions: Step 1: Wash 2 cup rice thoroughly in water 3 times.Boil 5 cup water on high flame for 5 minutes.Add rice and 1 tsp salt,then cook on medium flame for 12 minutes until rice becomes soft and separate.Drain excess water and cool for 15 minutes.Step 2: Heat 3 tbsp oil in a pan on medium flame for 2 minutes.Add 1 tsp mustard seeds and cook for 30 seconds until crackling.Step 3: Add 1 tbsp chana dal and 1 tbsp urad dal.Saute for 2 minutes until light golden.Step 4: Add 3 green chilli,1 tbsp ginger,and 1 tbsp curry leaves.Saute for 1 minute until aromatic.Step 5: Add 1 tsp turmeric powder and remaining 1 tsp salt.Mix on low flame for 30 seconds.Step 6: Add cooked rice and toss gently on low flame for 3 minutes until evenly coated.Step 7: Turn off flame and add 1/4 cup lemon juice.Mix gently for 1 minute and rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: veg noodles
instructions: Step 1: Boil 4 cup water in a large pot on high flame for 5 minutes.Add 1 tsp salt and 300 g noodles.Cook on medium flame for 6 minutes until soft but firm.Drain and rinse with cold water for 1 minute to stop cooking.Step 2: Heat 3 tbsp oil in a wok on high flame for 2 minutes.Add 1 tbsp garlic and saute for 30 seconds until aromatic.Step 3: Add 1 cup carrot,1 cup cabbage,and 1 cup capsicum.Stir fry on high flame for 5 minutes until vegetables become slightly soft but remain crunchy.Step 4: Add cooked noodles,2 tbsp soy sauce,1 tsp black pepper,and remaining salt.Toss continuously on high flame for 3 minutes until evenly mixed.Step 5: Add 1 cup spring onion and stir fry for 1 minute until fresh aroma develops.Step 6: Serve immediately while hot.

instructions: Step 1: Wash 1 kg beef thoroughly and cut into medium cubes.Add beef into a pressure cooker with 1 tbsp ginger,1 tbsp garlic,1 tbsp chilli powder,1 tbsp coriander powder,1/2 tsp turmeric powder,1 tsp salt,and 2 cup water.Pressure cook on high flame for 1 whistle and then on low flame for 30 minutes until tender.Step 2: Heat 4 tbsp coconut oil in a heavy pan on medium flame for 2 minutes.Add 2 cup onion,3 green chilli,remaining ginger,remaining garlic,and 2 tbsp curry leaves.Saute for 10 minutes until onions turn brown.Step 3: Add remaining chilli powder,coriander powder,turmeric powder,black pepper,fennel powder,and remaining salt.Roast on low flame for 2 minutes until aromatic.Step 4: Add cooked beef along with 1/2 cup cooking liquid.Cook uncovered on medium flame for 15 minutes while stirring every 2 minutes until masala thickens and beef becomes dark brown.Step 5: Add remaining curry leaves and roast on low flame for 3 minutes until oil separates clearly.Step 6: Rest for 5 minutes before serving hot.

title: vegetable sandwich
instructions: Step 1: Boil 2 cup potato in 4 cup water on medium flame for 20 minutes until soft.Peel and slice the potatoes thinly after cooling for 5 minutes.Step 2: Slice 1 cup onion,1 cup tomato,and 1 cup cucumber evenly.Step 3: Spread 1/2 tbsp butter and 1 tbsp green chutney evenly over each bread slice.Step 4: Arrange potato,onion,tomato,and cucumber slices over 4 bread slices.Sprinkle 1 tsp salt and 1 tsp black pepper evenly over the vegetables.Step 5: Cover with remaining bread slices and press gently.Step 6: Heat a sandwich pan on medium flame for 2 minutes.Apply remaining butter lightly on both sides of the sandwiches.Step 7: Toast each sandwich for 3 minutes on each side until golden brown and crisp.Step 8: Cut diagonally and serve hot.

title: chicken momos
instructions: Step 1: Mix 3 cup maida,1 tsp salt,and 1 cup water.Knead for 8 minutes until smooth dough forms.Cover and rest for 30 minutes.Step 2: Wash 500 g chicken thoroughly and mince finely using a mixer.Add chicken into a bowl with 1 cup onion,1 tbsp ginger,1 tbsp garlic,2 green chilli,1 cup cabbage,1 tbsp soy sauce,1 tbsp oil,and 1 tsp salt.Mix thoroughly for 3 minutes until evenly combined.Step 3: Divide the dough into small balls.Roll each into thin circles using a rolling pin.Step 4: Place 1 tbsp filling in the center of each circle.Fold and pinch edges tightly to seal completely.Step 5: Heat 3 cup water in a steamer on high flame for 5 minutes until steam forms.Grease steamer plates lightly with oil and arrange the momos with space between them.Step 6: Steam on medium flame for 12 minutes until outer covering becomes shiny and fully cooked.Step 7: Rest for 2 minutes before serving hot.

instructions: Step 1: Wash 2 cup green gram thoroughly and soak in 4 cup water for 6 hours.Drain completely.Step 2: Add soaked green gram into a pot with 3 cup water and 1 tsp salt.Cook on medium flame for 20 minutes until soft but not mushy.Drain excess water.Step 3: Heat 3 tbsp coconut oil in a pan on medium flame for 2 minutes.Add 1 tsp mustard seeds and cook for 30 seconds until crackling.Step 4: Add 1 cup onion,2 green chilli,and 1 tbsp curry leaves.Saute for 5 minutes until onions soften.Step 5: Add 1/2 tsp turmeric powder and cooked green gram.Stir on low flame for 3 minutes until evenly mixed.Step 6: Add 1 cup coconut and remaining 1 tsp salt.Mix thoroughly and cook on low flame for 4 minutes until coconut heats fully and mixture becomes dry.Step 7: Rest for 2 minutes before serving hot.

title: ney pathiri
instructions: Step 1: Add 3 cup maida,1 tsp sugar,and 1 tsp salt into a large bowl.Mix for 1 minute until evenly combined.Step 2: Add 2 tbsp ghee and rub into the flour using fingers for 3 minutes until crumbly texture forms.Step 3: Add 1 cup lukewarm water slowly and knead for 8 minutes until smooth soft dough forms.Cover and rest for 30 minutes at room temperature.Step 4: Divide the dough into small equal balls.Roll each ball into thin round discs using a rolling pin.Step 5: Heat 500 ml oil in a deep kadai on medium flame for 8 minutes until hot.Gently slide one pathiri into the oil and fry for 1 minute on each side until puffed and light golden.Step 6: Remove using a slotted spoon and drain excess oil.Repeat with remaining dough.Step 7: Cool for 3 minutes before serving.

title: prawn roast

instructions: Step 1: Wash 500 g prawns thoroughly,remove shell and vein,and drain completely.Apply 1/2 tsp turmeric powder and 1/2 tsp salt over the prawns.Rest for 10 minutes.Step 2: Heat 2 tbsp coconut oil in a pan on medium flame for 2 minutes.Add prawns and cook for 3 minutes until color changes and water releases.Remove and keep aside.Step 3: Heat remaining coconut oil in the same pan.Add 2 cup onion,2 green chilli,1 tbsp ginger,1 tbsp garlic,and 2 tbsp curry leaves.Saute for 10 minutes until onions turn deep golden brown.Step 4: Add 1 cup tomato and cook on medium flame for 5 minutes until soft and oil separates.Step 5: Add chilli powder,coriander powder,remaining turmeric powder,black pepper,and remaining salt.Roast on low flame for 2 minutes until aromatic.Step 6: Add cooked prawns and stir on medium flame for 5 minutes until masala coats the prawns completely and oil separates.Step 7: Rest for 3 minutes before serving hot.

title: veg pulao
instructions: Step 1: Wash 2 cup basmati rice in water 3 times and soak in 3 cup water for 20 minutes.Drain completely.Step 2: Heat 3 tbsp ghee in a heavy pot on medium flame for 2 minutes.Add 1 number cinnamon,4 number cloves,and 3 number cardamom.Saute for 30 seconds until aromatic.Step 3: Add 1 cup onion,2 green chilli,and 1 tbsp ginger.Saute for 5 minutes until onions soften.Step 4: Add 1 cup carrot,1 cup beans,and 1 cup green peas.Cook on medium flame for 4 minutes until slightly soft.Step 5: Add drained rice and stir gently for 2 minutes until coated with ghee.Step 6: Add 4 cup hot water and 2 tsp salt.Bring to boil on high flame for 5 minutes.Step 7: Cover and cook on low flame for 15 minutes until rice becomes soft and water fully absorbs.Step 8: Rest for 10 minutes before fluffing gently and serving.

title: alfaham chicken
instructions: Step 1: Wash 1 kg chicken thoroughly and make deep cuts on the pieces using a knife for better marination.Step 2: Mix 1 cup yogurt,2 tbsp garlic,2 tbsp ginger,1/4 cup lemon juice,2 tbsp chilli powder,1 tsp black pepper,1 tsp cumin powder,2 tbsp oil,and 2 tsp salt into a smooth marinade.Step 3: Apply the marinade evenly over the chicken and rub into the cuts.Rest covered for 4 hours inside a refrigerator or cool place.Step 4: Preheat oven on medium heat for 10 minutes.Grease a baking tray lightly with remaining oil and place the chicken pieces with space between them.Step 5: Bake the chicken for 25 minutes,then turn the pieces carefully and bake another 20 minutes until outer layer becomes charred and inner meat is fully cooked.Step 6: Rest for 5 minutes before serving hot.

title: yogurt rice
instructions: Step 1: Wash 2 cup rice thoroughly in water 3 times.Add rice and 6 cup water into a pot and cook on medium flame for 20 minutes until rice becomes very soft and slightly mushy.Cool for 15 minutes.Step 2: Mash the cooked rice lightly using a spoon until creamy texture forms.Step 3: Add 3 cup yogurt,1 cup milk,and 1 tsp salt.Mix thoroughly for 2 minutes until smooth.Step 4: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a small pan on medium flame for 2 minutes.Add 1 tsp mustard seeds and cook for 30 seconds until crackling.Step 5: Add 2 green chilli,1 tbsp ginger,and 1 tbsp curry leaves.Saute for 1 minute until aromatic.Step 6: Pour the tempering over the rice mixture and add remaining salt.Mix gently for 1 minute.Step 7: Rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: beef biryani

instructions: Step 1: Wash 1 kg beef thoroughly and cut into medium cubes.Marinate with 1 cup yogurt,2 tsp chilli powder,1 tsp turmeric powder,and 1 tsp salt for 30 minutes.Step 2: Wash 3 cup jeerakasala rice in water 2 times and soak in 4 cup water for 20 minutes.Drain completely.Step 3: Heat 2 tbsp ghee in a pressure cooker on medium flame.Add 2 cup onion and saute for 10 minutes until deep golden brown.Step 4: Add 4 green chilli,2 tbsp ginger,and 2 tbsp garlic.Saute for 3 minutes until aromatic.Step 5: Add 2 cup tomato and cook for 6 minutes until soft and oil separates.Step 6: Add marinated beef and cook on medium flame for 8 minutes until color changes.Add 1 cup water and pressure cook on high flame for 1 whistle,then on low flame for 25 minutes until tender.Step 7: Add mint leaves,coriander leaves,and 1 tsp garam masala into the cooked beef mixture.Simmer on low flame for 5 minutes until thick.Step 8: Heat remaining ghee in another pot.Add drained rice and roast gently for 2 minutes.Add 5 cup hot water and remaining salt.Cook on medium flame for 8 minutes until rice is 90 percent cooked.Step 9: Layer rice and beef masala in a heavy pot.Cover tightly and cook on very low flame for 20 minutes until fully cooked.Step 10: Rest for 10 minutes before gently mixing and serving.

title: veg burger
instructions: Step 1: Boil 2 cup potato,1 cup carrot,and 1 cup beans in 5 cup water on medium flame for 20 minutes until soft.Drain completely and mash lightly.Step 2: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a pan on medium flame for 2 minutes.Add 1 cup onion and 1 tbsp garlic.Saute for 4 minutes until soft.Step 3: Add mashed vegetables,1 tsp black pepper,and 2 tsp salt.Mix thoroughly and cook on low flame for 3 minutes until mixture becomes dry.Cool for 10 minutes.Step 4: Divide the mixture into equal patties and coat each patty evenly with 1 cup breadcrumbs.Step 5: Heat remaining oil in a pan on medium flame for 2 minutes.Shallow fry the patties for 4 minutes on each side until golden brown and crisp.Step 6: Slice 4 burger buns and toast lightly for 1 minute on a hot pan.Step 7: Spread mayonnaise and tomato sauce inside each bun.Place one patty inside and close the bun gently.Step 8: Serve immediately while warm.

title: kozhi nirachathu

instructions: Step 1: Wash 1 kg whole chicken thoroughly and drain completely.Apply 1 tsp chilli powder,1/2 tsp turmeric powder,and 1 tsp salt evenly over the chicken.Rest for 30 minutes.Step 2: Boil 2 eggs in 2 cup water on medium flame for 12 minutes until fully cooked.Cool,peel,and chop into small pieces.Step 3: Heat 2 tbsp coconut oil in a pan on medium flame for 2 minutes.Add 2 cup onion,2 green chilli,1 tbsp ginger,and 1 tbsp garlic.Saute for 8 minutes until golden brown.Step 4: Add chopped egg,1 cup breadcrumbs,1/2 cup raisins,remaining chilli powder,turmeric powder,garam masala,and remaining salt.Mix on low flame for 3 minutes until stuffing becomes dry.Cool for 5 minutes.Step 5: Fill the chicken cavity tightly with the stuffing and secure the opening using kitchen thread or toothpicks.Step 6: Heat remaining coconut oil in a heavy pan on medium flame for 2 minutes.Place the stuffed chicken carefully and cook covered for 15 minutes on each side until evenly browned and fully cooked inside.Step 7: Rest for 10 minutes before cutting and serving.

title: mushroom masala
instructions: Step 1: Wash 500 g mushroom thoroughly in water 2 times and slice evenly.Drain completely.Step 2: Heat 3 tbsp oil in a pan on medium flame for 2 minutes.Add 2 cup onion,2 green chilli,1 tbsp ginger,and 1 tbsp garlic.Saute for 8 minutes until onions become golden brown.Step 3: Add 2 cup tomato and cook on medium flame for 6 minutes until tomatoes soften and oil separates.Step 4: Add 1 tsp chilli powder,1 tbsp coriander powder,1 tsp garam masala,and 2 tsp salt.Roast on low flame for 2 minutes until aromatic.Step 5: Add mushroom and stir on medium flame for 5 minutes until mushrooms release water.Step 6: Add 2 cup water and simmer on medium flame for 10 minutes until gravy thickens slightly and mushrooms become tender.Step 7: Rest for 3 minutes before serving hot.

title: fish fried rice

title: peas pulao
instructions: Step 1: Wash 2 cup basmati rice in water 3 times and soak in 3 cup water for 20 minutes.Drain completely.Step 2: Heat 3 tbsp ghee in a heavy pot on medium flame for 2 minutes.Add 1 number cinnamon and 4 number cloves.Saute for 30 seconds until aromatic.Step 3: Add 1 cup onion,2 green chilli,and 1 tbsp ginger.Saute for 5 minutes until onions soften.Step 4: Add 2 cup green peas and cook on medium flame for 3 minutes until slightly soft.Step 5: Add drained rice and stir gently for 2 minutes until coated with ghee.Step 6: Add 4 cup hot water and 2 tsp salt.Bring to boil on high flame for 5 minutes.Step 7: Cover and cook on low flame for 15 minutes until rice becomes soft and water fully absorbs.Step 8: Rest for 10 minutes before fluffing gently and serving.

title: veg cutlet

title: paneer tikka

instructions: Step 1: Finely chop 2 cup cabbage,1 cup carrot,and 1 cup beans.Place into a large bowl and squeeze gently for 2 minutes to remove excess moisture.Step 2: Add 1/2 cup corn flour,1/2 cup maida,and 1 tsp salt.Mix thoroughly until the vegetables bind together.Shape into small balls.Step 3: Heat 500 ml oil in a deep kadai on medium flame for 8 minutes until hot.Fry the vegetable balls in batches for 5 minutes until golden brown and crisp.Drain excess oil.Step 4: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a wok on high flame for 1 minute.Add 1 tbsp garlic,2 green chilli,and 1 cup onion.Stir fry for 2 minutes until aromatic.Step 5: Add 2 tbsp soy sauce,2 tbsp tomato sauce,1 tbsp chilli sauce,remaining corn flour mixed with 1 cup water,and remaining salt.Cook on medium flame for 3 minutes until sauce thickens.Step 6: Add fried vegetable balls and toss on high flame for 2 minutes until evenly coated.Step 7: Rest for 1 minute before serving hot.

title: beef noodles
instructions: Step 1: Wash 300 g beef thoroughly and cut into thin strips.Add beef into a pressure cooker with 1 cup water and 1 tsp salt.Pressure cook on high flame for 1 whistle and then on low flame for 15 minutes until tender.Drain excess liquid.Step 2: Boil 5 cup water in a large pot on high flame for 5 minutes.Add noodles and cook on medium flame for 6 minutes until soft but firm.Drain and rinse with cold water for 1 minute.Step 3: Heat 4 tbsp oil in a wok on high flame for 2 minutes.Add 1 tbsp garlic and saute for 30 seconds until aromatic.Step 4: Add 1 cup onion,1 cup cabbage,and 1 cup capsicum.Stir fry for 5 minutes until slightly soft.Step 5: Add cooked beef,cooked noodles,2 tbsp soy sauce,1 tsp black pepper,and remaining salt.Toss continuously on high flame for 4 minutes until evenly mixed.Step 6: Rest for 1 minute before serving hot.

title: pineapple pachadi
instructions: Step 1: Wash 2 cup pineapple thoroughly and cut into small cubes.Add pineapple and 1 cup water into a saucepan.Cook on medium flame for 10 minutes until pineapple becomes soft.Step 2: Grind 1 cup coconut,2 green chilli,and 1/2 tsp mustard seeds with 1/4 cup water for 5 minutes until smooth paste forms.Step 3: Add ground coconut paste and 1 tsp salt into the cooked pineapple.Mix thoroughly and cook on low flame for 5 minutes until slightly thickened.Step 4: Turn off flame and cool for 10 minutes.Add 2 cup yogurt and mix gently until smooth.Step 5: Heat 2 tbsp coconut oil in a small pan on medium flame for 1 minute.Add remaining mustard seeds and 1 tbsp curry leaves.Cook for 30 seconds until crackling.Step 6: Pour the tempering over the pachadi and mix gently.Rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: chicken pasta
instructions: Step 1: Wash 300 g chicken thoroughly and cut into small cubes.Heat 1 tbsp oil in a pan on medium flame for 2 minutes.Add chicken and 1/2 tsp salt.Cook for 6 minutes until fully cooked and lightly browned.Remove carefully.Step 2: Boil 5 cup water in a large pot on high flame for 5 minutes.Add remaining salt and 300 g pasta.Cook on medium flame for 10 minutes until soft but firm.Drain completely.Step 3: Heat remaining oil in a pan on medium flame for 2 minutes.Add 1 tbsp garlic and saute for 30 seconds until aromatic.Step 4: Add 1 cup onion and cook for 4 minutes until soft.Step 5: Add 2 cup tomato and cook on medium flame for 6 minutes until tomatoes break down and sauce thickens.Step 6: Add black pepper and oregano.Stir on low flame for 1 minute until aromatic.Step 7: Add cooked chicken and pasta.Toss gently on medium flame for 3 minutes until evenly coated.Step 8: Rest for 2 minutes before serving hot.

title: avial
instructions: Step 1: Wash and peel 1 cup carrot,1 cup raw banana,and 1 cup yam.Cut all vegetables including 1 cup beans and 1 cup drumstick into long medium pieces.Step 2: Add all vegetables into a large pot with 3 cup water and 2 tsp salt.Cook covered on medium flame for 15 minutes until vegetables become soft but not mushy.Step 3: Grind 2 cup coconut,3 green chilli,and 1 tsp cumin seeds with 1/2 cup water for 5 minutes until coarse paste forms.Step 4: Add the ground coconut paste into the cooked vegetables.Mix gently and cook on low flame for 5 minutes until thick and aromatic.Step 5: Turn off flame and cool for 5 minutes.Add 1 cup yogurt and mix gently to avoid curdling.Step 6: Add 3 tbsp coconut oil and 1 tbsp curry leaves over the avial.Cover and rest for 10 minutes before serving.

title: kozhukatta
instructions: Step 1: Heat 1 cup water in a saucepan on medium flame for 3 minutes.Add 1 cup jaggery and stir for 4 minutes until fully dissolved.Filter and cool for 5 minutes.Step 2: Add 1 cup coconut and 1 tsp cardamom powder into the jaggery syrup.Mix thoroughly for 2 minutes until evenly combined.Step 3: Boil remaining water on high flame for 5 minutes.Add 1 tsp salt.Step 4: Place 2 cup rice flour in a large bowl and slowly pour the hot water while mixing with a spoon for 3 minutes until soft dough forms.Rest for 5 minutes and knead for 4 minutes until smooth.Step 5: Divide the dough into small balls.Flatten each ball into a small cup shape using wet fingers.Place 1 tbsp coconut jaggery filling in the center and seal carefully into oval shapes.Step 6: Heat 3 cup water in a steamer on high flame for 5 minutes until steam forms.Arrange kozhukatta on greased plates and steam on medium flame for 12 minutes until firm and glossy.Step 7: Rest for 5 minutes before serving warm.

title: beef cutlet

instructions: Step 1: Wash 750 g prawns thoroughly,remove shell and vein,and drain completely.Step 2: Heat 4 tbsp coconut oil in a deep pan on medium flame for 2 minutes.Add 2 cup onion,3 green chilli,2 tbsp ginger,2 tbsp garlic,and 2 tbsp curry leaves.Saute for 10 minutes until onions turn deep golden brown.Step 3: Add 2 cup tomato and cook on medium flame for 6 minutes until soft and oil separates.Step 4: Add 2 tbsp chilli powder,2 tbsp coriander powder,1 tsp turmeric powder,1 tsp garam masala,and 3 tsp salt.Roast on low flame for 2 minutes until aromatic.Step 5: Add prawns and stir on high flame for 5 minutes until moisture releases.Step 6: Add 4 cup water and bring to boil on high flame for 5 minutes.Cook on medium flame for 10 minutes until prawns become tender and gravy thickens slightly.Step 7: Rest for 5 minutes before serving hot.

instructions: Step 1: Wash 1 kg mutton and cut into small pieces. Mix with 2 tsp chilli powder,2 tsp black pepper,1 tsp fennel powder,1 tsp garam masala,and 3 tsp salt. Rest for 30 minutes. Step 2: Heat 5 tbsp coconut oil in a wide heavy pan on medium flame for 2 minutes. Add 2 cup shallots,3 green chilli,2 tbsp ginger,2 tbsp garlic,and 2 tbsp curry leaves. Saute for 8 minutes until the shallots brown lightly. Step 3: Add the marinated mutton and stir-fry on medium flame for 10 minutes until the outside browns. Cover and cook on low flame for 25 minutes,stirring every few minutes so it does not stick. Step 4: Add 1 cup coconut pieces and fry uncovered for 12 minutes until the mutton turns dark,roasted,and dry. Rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: paneer manchurian
ingredients: paneer,onion,capsicum,garlic,green chilli,corn flour,maida,soy sauce,tomato sauce,chilli sauce,oil,salt,water

instructions: Step 1: Cut 400 g paneer into medium cubes.Mix paneer with 1/2 cup corn flour,1/2 cup maida,and 1 tsp salt until evenly coated.Rest for 10 minutes.Step 2: Heat 500 ml oil in a deep kadai on medium flame for 8 minutes until hot.Fry paneer cubes in batches for 4 minutes until golden brown and crisp.Drain excess oil.Step 3: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a wok on high flame for 1 minute.Add 1 tbsp garlic and 2 green chilli.Saute for 1 minute until aromatic.Step 4: Add 1 cup onion and 1 cup capsicum.Stir fry for 3 minutes until slightly soft.Step 5: Add 2 tbsp soy sauce,2 tbsp tomato sauce,1 tbsp chilli sauce,remaining corn flour mixed with 1 cup water,and remaining salt.Cook on medium flame for 3 minutes until sauce thickens.Step 6: Add fried paneer and toss on high flame for 2 minutes until evenly coated.Step 7: Rest for 1 minute before serving hot.

title: veg pasta
instructions: Step 1: Boil 5 cup water in a large pot on high flame for 5 minutes.Add 1 tsp salt and 300 g pasta.Cook on medium flame for 10 minutes until soft but firm.Drain completely.Step 2: Heat 3 tbsp oil in a pan on medium flame for 2 minutes.Add 1 tbsp garlic and saute for 30 seconds until aromatic.Step 3: Add 1 cup onion and 1 cup capsicum.Cook on medium flame for 5 minutes until slightly soft.Step 4: Add 2 cup tomato and cook on medium flame for 8 minutes until tomatoes become soft and sauce thickens.Step 5: Add 1 tsp oregano,1 tsp black pepper,and remaining salt.Mix thoroughly and cook on low flame for 1 minute until aromatic.Step 6: Add cooked pasta and toss gently on medium flame for 3 minutes until evenly coated.Step 7: Rest for 2 minutes before serving hot.

title: mushroom fried rice
instructions: Step 1: Wash 3 cup rice thoroughly in water 3 times.Boil 6 cup water on high flame for 5 minutes.Add rice and 1 tsp salt.Cook on medium flame for 12 minutes until grains become soft and separate.Drain excess water and cool for 20 minutes.Step 2: Wash 300 g mushroom thoroughly and slice evenly.Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok on medium flame for 2 minutes.Add mushroom and cook for 5 minutes until moisture evaporates and mushrooms become lightly browned.Remove carefully.Step 3: Heat remaining oil in the wok on high flame for 2 minutes.Add 1 tbsp garlic and saute for 30 seconds until aromatic.Step 4: Add 1 cup onion,1 cup carrot,and 1 cup cabbage.Stir fry for 5 minutes until slightly soft.Step 5: Add cooled rice,cooked mushroom,2 tbsp soy sauce,1 tsp black pepper,and remaining salt.Toss continuously on high flame for 4 minutes until evenly mixed.Step 6: Rest for 1 minute before serving hot.

title: semiya payasam
instructions: Step 1: Heat 2 tbsp ghee in a heavy pan on medium flame for 2 minutes.Add 2 cup vermicelli and roast for 5 minutes while stirring continuously until golden brown and aromatic.Step 2: Heat 2 liter milk in a large pot on medium flame for 10 minutes until slightly hot.Add roasted vermicelli and cook on low flame for 12 minutes while stirring every 2 minutes until vermicelli becomes soft.Step 3: Add 1.5 cup sugar gradually and stir continuously for 5 minutes until fully dissolved.Step 4: Add 1 tsp cardamom powder and mix thoroughly for 1 minute until aromatic.Step 5: Heat remaining ghee in a small pan on medium flame for 1 minute.Add 1/2 cup cashew nuts and fry for 2 minutes until golden brown.Add 1/4 cup raisins and fry for 1 minute until swollen.Step 6: Pour fried cashew nuts and raisins into the payasam.Mix gently and rest for 10 minutes before serving.

title: chicken noodles
instructions: Step 1: Boil 5 cup water in a large pot on high flame for 5 minutes.Add 1 tsp salt and 300 g noodles.Cook on medium flame for 6 minutes until soft but firm.Drain and rinse with cold water for 1 minute.Step 2: Wash 500 g chicken thoroughly and cut into thin strips.Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok on medium flame for 2 minutes.Add chicken and cook for 8 minutes until fully cooked and lightly browned.Remove carefully.Step 3: Heat remaining oil in the wok on high flame for 2 minutes.Add 1 tbsp garlic and saute for 30 seconds until aromatic.Step 4: Add 1 cup onion,1 cup cabbage,1 cup carrot,and 1 cup capsicum.Stir fry for 5 minutes until slightly soft.Step 5: Add cooked noodles,cooked chicken,2 tbsp soy sauce,1 tsp black pepper,and remaining salt.Toss continuously on high flame for 4 minutes until evenly mixed.Step 6: Rest for 1 minute before serving hot.

title: bisibelebath
instructions: Step 1: Wash 2 cup rice and 1 cup toor dal thoroughly in water 3 times.Soak separately in 3 cup water for 20 minutes.Step 2: Wash and peel 1 cup carrot and 1 cup potato.Cut carrot,potato,and beans into medium cubes.Step 3: Pressure cook rice and toor dal with 6 cup water on high flame for 1 whistle and then on low flame for 12 minutes until soft and mushy.Step 4: Soak 1/4 cup tamarind in 1 cup warm water for 10 minutes.Extract thick tamarind juice and strain it.Step 5: Heat 3 tbsp ghee in a large pot on medium flame for 2 minutes.Add 1 cup onion and saute for 5 minutes until soft.Step 6: Add tomato,carrot,beans,and potato.Cook on medium flame for 8 minutes until slightly soft.Step 7: Add tamarind extract,2 tsp chilli powder,1 tbsp coriander powder,and 2 tsp salt.Cook on medium flame for 5 minutes until raw smell disappears.Step 8: Add cooked rice and dal mixture.Mix thoroughly and simmer on low flame for 10 minutes until thick and creamy.Step 9: Rest for 5 minutes before serving hot.

title: fish fingers
instructions: Step 1: Wash 500 g fish thoroughly and cut into long finger-sized strips.Drain completely.Step 2: Grind 1 tbsp garlic into coarse paste using 1 tbsp water.Mix garlic paste,1 tsp black pepper,and 2 tsp salt.Apply evenly over fish strips and rest for 20 minutes.Step 3: Place 1 cup maida in one bowl.Beat 2 eggs in another bowl for 2 minutes until frothy.Place 2 cup breadcrumbs in a third bowl.Step 4: Coat each fish strip first with maida,then dip into beaten egg,and finally coat evenly with breadcrumbs.Step 5: Heat 500 ml oil in a deep kadai on medium flame for 8 minutes until hot.Fry fish fingers in batches for 4 minutes until golden brown and crisp.Step 6: Drain excess oil for 2 minutes before serving hot.

title: chicken roast biryani
ingredients: jeerakasala rice,chicken,onion,tomato,green chilli,ginger,garlic,yogurt,mint leaves,coriander leaves,ghee,chilli powder,black pepper,garam masala,salt,water

instructions: Step 1: Wash 1 kg chicken thoroughly and cut into medium pieces.Marinate with 1 cup yogurt,2 tsp chilli powder,1 tsp black pepper,and 1 tsp salt for 30 minutes.Step 2: Heat 2 tbsp ghee in a heavy pan on medium flame.Add marinated chicken and roast for 15 minutes while stirring until chicken becomes browned and partially cooked.Remove carefully.Step 3: Wash 3 cup jeerakasala rice in water 2 times and soak in 4 cup water for 20 minutes.Drain completely.Step 4: Heat remaining ghee in a heavy pot.Add 2 cup onion and saute for 10 minutes until deep golden brown.Step 5: Add green chilli,ginger,and garlic.Saute for 3 minutes until aromatic.Step 6: Add tomato and cook for 6 minutes until soft and oil separates.Add roasted chicken,mint leaves,coriander leaves,garam masala,and remaining salt.Simmer for 8 minutes until masala thickens.Step 7: In another pot roast drained rice for 2 minutes.Add 5 cup hot water and cook on medium flame for 8 minutes until rice is 90 percent cooked.Step 8: Layer rice and chicken roast masala in a heavy pot.Cover tightly and cook on very low flame for 20 minutes until fully cooked.Step 9: Rest for 10 minutes before gently mixing and serving.

title: idli
instructions: Step 1: Wash 3 cup idli rice and 1 cup urad dal separately in water 2 times each. Soak the rice in 2 cup water and the urad dal with 1 tsp fenugreek seeds in 2 cup water for 6 hours. Step 2: Drain the rice and grind it with 1/2 cup water for 6 minutes until smooth. Drain the dal and fenugreek seeds and grind them with 1/2 cup water for 6 minutes until fluffy. Step 3: Combine both batters with 2 tsp salt and ferment covered for 8 hours at room temperature until the batter rises and looks airy. Step 4: Heat 1 cup water in a steamer base on high flame for 5 minutes until steam forms. Grease idli plates,fill them with batter,place them in the steamer,and cook on medium flame for 10 minutes until the idlis become firm and spring back when touched. Step 5: Rest for 2 minutes before removing and serving hot.

title: sambar
ingredients: toor dal,onion,drumstick,carrot,tomato,sambar powder,tamarind,curry leaves,mustard seeds,oil,turmeric powder,salt,water
ingredient_measurements: [{"ingredient":"toor dal","measurement":"1 cup","quantity":"","unit":"","note":""},{"ingredient":"onion","measurement":"1 cup","quantity":"","unit":"","note":""},{"ingredient":"drumstick","measurement":"1 cup","quantity":"","unit":"","note":""},{"ingredient":"carrot","measurement":"1 cup","quantity":"","unit":"","note":""},{"ingredient":"tomato","measurement":"1 cup","quantity":"","unit":"","note":""},{"ingredient":"sambar powder","measurement":"2 tbsp","quantity":"","unit":"","note":""},{"ingredient":"tamarind","measurement":"1/4 cup","quantity":"","unit":"","note":""},{"ingredient":"curry leaves","measurement":"1 tbsp","quantity":"","unit":"","note":""},{"ingredient":"mustard seeds","measurement":"1 tsp","quantity":"","unit":"","note":""},{"ingredient":"oil","measurement":"3 tbsp","quantity":"","unit":"","note":""},{"ingredient":"turmeric powder","measurement":"1 tsp","quantity":"","unit":"","note":""},{"ingredient":"salt","measurement":"2 tsp","quantity":"","unit":"","note":""},{"ingredient":"water","measurement":"7 cup","quantity":"","unit":"","note":""}]
instructions: Step 1: Wash 1 cup toor dal thoroughly and add it to a pressure cooker with 3 cup water and 1 tsp turmeric powder. Pressure cook on high flame for 1 whistle,then on low flame for 12 minutes until the dal becomes soft and mashable. Step 2: Soak 1/4 cup tamarind in 1 cup warm water for 10 minutes,and strain it to get smooth tamarind extract. Step 3: Heat 3 tbsp oil in a deep pan on medium flame for 2 minutes. Add 1 tsp mustard seeds and cook for 30 seconds until they crackle. Add 1 tbsp curry leaves,1 cup onion,1 cup drumstick,1 cup carrot,and 1 cup tomato. Saute for 5 minutes until the onions soften slightly. Step 4: Add the cooked dal,2 tbsp sambar powder,2 tsp salt,and 1 cup water. Simmer on medium flame for 8 minutes until the vegetables become tender and the sambar starts thickening. Step 5: Add the tamarind extract and the remaining 1 cup water. Boil on low flame for 5 minutes until the raw tamarind smell disappears and the sambar tastes balanced. Step 6: Rest for 5 minutes before serving hot.

title: rasam

instructions: Step 1: Soak 1/4 cup tamarind in 1 cup warm water for 10 minutes and strain it to make tamarind extract. Step 2: Crush 1 tbsp garlic,1 tsp cumin seeds,and 1 tsp black pepper together using a mortar or mixer until coarse. Step 3: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a pan on medium flame for 1 minute. Add 1 tsp mustard seeds and cook for 30 seconds until they crackle. Add 1 tbsp curry leaves and the crushed garlic spice mixture,then saute for 30 seconds until aromatic. Step 4: Add 2 cup tomato and 2 cup water,then cook on medium flame for 6 minutes until the tomatoes soften completely and start breaking down. Step 5: Add 1 tbsp rasam powder,1 tsp salt,the tamarind extract,and the remaining 3 cup water. Boil on low flame for 8 minutes until the rasam turns slightly frothy and aromatic. Step 6: Turn off the flame and rest for 3 minutes before serving hot.

title: pazham pori
instructions: Step 1: Peel 4 number raw banana and slice them lengthwise into medium-thin pieces. Step 2: Mix 1 cup maida,1/2 cup rice flour,2 tbsp sugar,1/4 tsp turmeric powder,and 1/4 tsp baking soda in a bowl. Add 1 cup water slowly and whisk for 2 minutes until a smooth batter forms with no lumps. Step 3: Heat 500 ml coconut oil in a deep kadai on medium flame for 8 minutes until hot. Step 4: Dip each banana slice into the batter so it is fully coated,then slide it carefully into the hot oil. Fry in batches on medium flame for 3 minutes on each side until golden brown and crisp. Step 5: Drain on a plate for 2 minutes and serve warm.

title: ulli vada

instructions: Step 1: Slice 3 cup onion thinly and place it in a large bowl. Add 3 green chilli,1 tbsp curry leaves,1 tsp cumin seeds,1/2 tsp turmeric powder,and 1 tsp salt. Mix for 1 minute and rest for 5 minutes until the onions release moisture. Step 2: Add 1 cup besan and 1/4 cup rice flour to the onion mixture. Sprinkle 1/2 cup water slowly while mixing for 2 minutes until the onions bind into a thick,sticky mixture. Step 3: Heat 500 ml oil in a deep kadai on medium flame for 8 minutes until hot. Step 4: Drop small portions of the mixture into the oil and fry on medium flame for 4 minutes,turning once,until the vadas turn deep golden brown and crisp. Step 5: Drain for 2 minutes before serving hot.

instructions: Step 1: Heat a dry pan on low flame for 2 minutes. Add 2 cup semiya and roast for 4 minutes while stirring continuously until it turns light golden and aromatic. Remove and keep aside. Step 2: Heat 3 tbsp oil in the same pan on medium flame for 1 minute. Add 1 tsp mustard seeds,1 tbsp chana dal,and 1 tbsp urad dal. Cook for 1 minute until the dals turn light golden. Step 3: Add 1 tbsp curry leaves,2 green chilli,1 tbsp ginger,1 cup onion,1 cup carrot,and 1 cup green peas. Saute on medium flame for 5 minutes until the onion softens. Step 4: Add 3 cup water and 2 tsp salt. Bring to a boil on high flame for 3 minutes. Step 5: Add the roasted semiya and the remaining 1 cup water. Cook on low flame for 4 minutes while stirring gently until the water absorbs and the semiya becomes soft but separate. Step 6: Rest for 2 minutes before serving hot.

title: cherupayar curry
ingredients: green,onion,green chilli,ginger,coconut,cumin seeds,curry leaves,coconut oil,mustard seeds,salt,water

instructions: Step 1: Wash 2 cup green gram and soak it in 4 cup water for 4 hours. Drain the soaked green gram. Step 2: Add the soaked green gram to a pressure cooker with 1 cup water and 1 tsp salt. Pressure cook on high flame for 1 whistle,then on low flame for 10 minutes until the green gram becomes soft but still holds shape. Step 3: Grind 1 cup coconut,1 tsp cumin seeds,1 tbsp ginger,and 3 green chilli with the remaining 1 cup water until it becomes a coarse paste. Step 4: Heat 3 tbsp coconut oil in a pan on medium flame for 1 minute. Add 1 tsp mustard seeds and cook for 30 seconds until they crackle. Add 1 tbsp curry leaves and 1 cup onion,then saute for 5 minutes until the onion turns soft and light golden. Step 5: Add the cooked green gram,coconut paste,and remaining 1 tsp salt. Simmer on low flame for 5 minutes until the curry becomes creamy and slightly thick. Step 6: Rest for 3 minutes before serving hot.

title: kappa puzhukku
instructions: Step 1: Peel 1 kg tapioca and cut it into medium cubes. Wash the pieces in water 2 times to remove excess starch. Step 2: Add the tapioca to a large pot with 5 cup water and 2 tsp salt. Boil on high flame for 5 minutes,then cook on medium flame for 18 minutes until the tapioca becomes soft and breaks easily with a spoon. Step 3: Drain the excess water and mash the tapioca lightly so some pieces remain visible. Step 4: Grind 1 cup coconut,3 green chilli,and 1 tsp cumin seeds into a coarse mixture without adding extra water. Mix this into the hot tapioca and cook on low flame for 3 minutes until the coconut smells fragrant. Step 5: Heat 3 tbsp coconut oil in a small pan on medium flame for 1 minute. Add 1 tbsp curry leaves and cook for 20 seconds until crisp. Pour the tempering over the kappa and mix gently. Step 6: Rest for 5 minutes before serving hot.

title: egg bhurji
instructions: Step 1: Crack 4 eggs into a bowl. Add 1 tsp salt and beat for 1 minute until evenly mixed. Step 2: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a pan on medium flame for 1 minute. Add 1 cup onion,2 green chilli,1 tbsp ginger,and 1 tbsp curry leaves. Saute for 4 minutes until the onion softens. Step 3: Add 1 cup tomato,1/2 tsp turmeric powder,and 1 tsp chilli powder. Cook on medium flame for 5 minutes until the tomato becomes soft and the masala looks glossy. Step 4: Pour in the beaten eggs and cook on low flame for 3 minutes without stirring too much until the eggs start setting. Step 5: Stir gently and cook for 2 more minutes until the egg bhurji becomes soft,fully cooked,and slightly moist. Step 6: Rest for 1 minute before serving hot.

title: banana chips
instructions: Step 1: Peel 6 number raw banana and slice them into thin even rounds. Step 2: Mix 2 cup water with 1 tsp turmeric powder and 1 tsp salt in a large bowl. Soak the banana slices for 5 minutes,then drain them completely. Step 3: Heat 500 ml coconut oil in a deep kadai on medium flame for 8 minutes until hot. Step 4: Add the banana slices in small batches and fry on medium flame for 4 minutes until the bubbles reduce and the chips turn light golden and crisp. Step 5: Remove with a slotted spoon and drain for 2 minutes before serving.

title: ghee rice
instructions: Step 1: Wash 2 cup basmati rice in water 3 times and soak it in 3 cup water for 20 minutes. Drain completely. Step 2: Heat 4 tbsp ghee in a heavy pot on medium flame for 2 minutes. Add 1 number bay leaf,1 number cinnamon,4 number cloves,and 3 number cardamom. Saute for 30 seconds until aromatic. Step 3: Add 1 cup onion and cook on medium flame for 6 minutes until the onion turns soft and light golden. Step 4: Add 1/2 cup cashew nuts and fry for 2 minutes until golden. Add 1/4 cup raisins and cook for 1 minute until swollen. Step 5: Add the drained rice and 2 tsp salt,then stir gently for 2 minutes until each grain is coated with ghee. Step 6: Add 4 cup hot water and bring to a boil on high flame for 5 minutes. Cover and cook on low flame for 15 minutes until the water is fully absorbed and the rice becomes fluffy. title: kallummakkaya fry

instructions: Step 1: Wash 500 g mussels thoroughly and clean the shells well. Steam them in a covered pot with 1 cup water on high flame for 5 minutes until the shells open. Coat the mussel meat with this mixture and rest for 15 minutes. Step 3: Sprinkle 1/2 cup rice flour over the marinated mussels and toss gently for 1 minute until lightly coated. Step 4: Heat 500 ml coconut oil in a deep kadai on medium flame for 8 minutes until hot. Fry the mussels in batches on medium flame for 3 minutes until the coating turns crisp and light golden. title: chatti pathiri
instructions: Step 1: Mix 2 cup maida,2 number egg,1 tsp salt,and 2 cup water in a bowl to form a thin batter. Rest for 10 minutes. Step 2: Heat a nonstick pan on medium flame for 1 minute and pour 1 ladle batter to make a thin crepe. Cook for 1 minute on one side only until set but not browned. Repeat to make 6 to 8 crepes. Step 3: Wash 300 g chicken and cook it in a pan with 1 tbsp oil,1 cup onion,2 green chilli,1 tbsp ginger,1 tbsp garlic,1 cup tomato,1 tsp turmeric powder,1 tsp garam masala,and 1 tsp salt on medium flame for 15 minutes until the chicken becomes fully cooked and the masala turns dry. Add 1/4 cup coriander leaves and cool for 5 minutes. Step 4: Place one crepe in a greased pan,spread a thin layer of chicken filling,cover with another crepe,then repeat the layering until the filling finishes. Beat the remaining 2 number egg lightly and pour it over the top layer. Step 5: Cook the layered chatti pathiri on low flame for 8 minutes,covering the pan,until the top sets and the bottom turns lightly golden. Step 6: Rest for 5 minutes before cutting into pieces and serving warm.

title: neer dosa
instructions: Step 1: Wash 2 cup rice thoroughly and soak it in 4 cup water for 6 hours. Drain completely. Step 2: Grind the soaked rice with 1 cup coconut,1 tsp salt,and 2 cup water for 8 minutes until a very thin smooth batter forms. Add the remaining 2 cup water and mix well. Step 3: Rest the batter for 15 minutes so the rice settles evenly. Step 4: Heat a tawa on medium flame for 2 minutes. Pour 1 ladle batter and immediately tilt the pan to spread it as a thin lace-like dosa. Step 5: Cover and cook on low flame for 1 minute until the top turns dry and the edges lift easily. Step 6: Remove carefully and repeat with the remaining batter. Serve hot.

title: unnakaya
instructions: Step 1: Boil 5 number raw banana in 2 cup water on medium flame for 12 minutes until the skins darken and the bananas become soft. Cool for 5 minutes,peel them,and mash into a smooth dough with 1 tsp salt. Step 2: Heat 1 tbsp ghee in a pan on medium flame for 1 minute. Add 1/4 cup cashew nuts and fry for 2 minutes until golden. Add 1/4 cup raisins and fry for 1 minute until swollen. Step 3: Add 1 cup coconut,2 tbsp sugar,and 1 tsp cardamom powder. Cook on low flame for 3 minutes until the filling becomes dry and fragrant. Cool for 5 minutes. Step 4: Flatten each banana portion in your palm,place 1 tbsp filling inside,seal carefully into oval shapes,and repeat for all pieces. Step 5: Heat the remaining 2 tbsp ghee in a pan on medium flame for 1 minute. Lightly pan-fry the stuffed pieces for 2 minutes on each side until golden brown. Step 6: Rest for 3 minutes before serving warm.

title: rava kesari
instructions: Step 1: Heat 2 tbsp ghee in a pan on low flame for 1 minute. Add 1 cup rava and roast for 5 minutes while stirring continuously until it turns aromatic and light golden. Step 2: In another pot, boil 3 cup water on high flame for 5 minutes. Add 0.25 tsp food color and 1 cup sugar,then stir for 1 minute until dissolved. Step 3: Reduce the flame to low and slowly add the roasted rava while stirring continuously for 3 minutes to avoid lumps. Step 4: Cook on low flame for 5 minutes until the mixture thickens and starts leaving the sides of the pan. Step 5: Heat remaining 2 tbsp ghee in a small pan on medium flame for 1 minute. Add 1/4 cup cashew nuts and fry for 2 minutes until golden brown. Add 1/4 cup raisins and fry for 1 minute until swollen. Step 6: Add cashew nuts,raisins,and 1 tsp cardamom powder to the kesari. Mix gently and cook on low flame for 2 minutes until glossy. Step 7: Rest for 5 minutes before serving warm.

Simmer on low flame for 8 minutes until the curry becomes thick and the roasted coconut flavor blends well. Step 6: Rest for 5 minutes before serving hot.

title: oats idli
instructions: Step 1: Dry roast 2 cup oats on low flame for 4 minutes until lightly aromatic. Cool for 5 minutes and grind into coarse powder. Step 2: Mix the oats powder with 1 cup semolina,1 cup yogurt,1 cup grated carrot,2 number green chilli,1 tbsp curry leaves,1 tsp salt,and 1 cup water in a bowl. Rest for 15 minutes so the semolina softens. Step 3: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a small pan on medium flame for 1 minute. Add 1 tsp mustard seeds and cook for 30 seconds until they crackle. Pour the tempering into the batter and mix well. Step 4: Add the remaining 1 cup water slowly until the batter reaches a thick pouring consistency. Step 5: Grease idli plates lightly and fill them with batter. Steam in a preheated steamer on medium flame for 12 minutes until the idlis are firm and spring back when pressed. Step 6: Rest for 2 minutes before removing and serving hot.

title: kallappam
instructions: Step 1: Wash 2 cup raw rice thoroughly and soak in 4 cup water for 4 hours. Drain completely. Step 2: Heat 1 cup water in a pan on medium flame for 3 minutes. Add 1 cup jaggery and stir for 4 minutes until dissolved. Cool for 5 minutes. Step 3: Dissolve 1 tsp yeast in 1/4 cup lukewarm water and rest for 10 minutes until frothy. Step 4: Grind soaked rice,1 cup cooked rice,1 cup coconut,the jaggery syrup,and the yeast mixture with 2 cup water for 8 minutes until a smooth batter forms. Add 1 tsp salt and mix well. Step 5: Cover and ferment the batter for 8 hours at room temperature until it becomes airy and slightly risen. Step 6: Heat an appam pan on medium flame for 2 minutes. Pour 1 ladle batter into the center,cover,and cook on low flame for 3 minutes until the top sets and the bottom turns light golden. Step 7: Remove carefully and serve hot.

title: beetroot pachadi
instructions: Step 1: Wash and peel 2 cup beetroot,then grate it finely. Cook it with 2 cup water and 1 tsp salt on medium flame for 12 minutes until soft. Drain any extra water and cool for 5 minutes. Step 2: Grind 1 cup coconut and 3 number green chilli with 1/2 cup water for 3 minutes until smooth. Step 3: Mix the cooled beetroot with the coconut paste and cook on low flame for 4 minutes until the mixture turns thick and well combined. Step 4: Turn off the flame and cool for 10 minutes. Add 2 cup yogurt and mix gently for 1 minute until creamy. Step 5: Heat 2 tbsp coconut oil in a small pan on medium flame for 1 minute. title: achappam
instructions: Step 1: Mix 2 cup rice flour,2 tbsp sugar,1 tsp salt,1 tbsp sesame seeds,and 1 tsp cumin seeds in a bowl. Step 2: Add 1 number egg and 1 cup coconut milk slowly while whisking for 3 minutes until a smooth batter forms with the consistency of thick cream. Rest for 15 minutes. Step 3: Heat 500 ml oil in a deep kadai on medium flame for 8 minutes until hot. Dip the achappam mould in the hot oil for 30 seconds,then dip it halfway into the batter without covering the top edge. Step 4: Return the batter-coated mould to the oil and fry for 30 to 40 seconds until the snack releases from the mould and turns golden brown. Step 5: Fry the released achappam for another 30 seconds until crisp. Drain on a plate for 2 minutes and repeat with the remaining batter. Step 6: Cool for 5 minutes before serving.

title: chakka pradhaman

Step 3: Add 3 cup coconut milk gradually and simmer on very low flame for 10 minutes until the pradhaman thickens slightly. Step 4: Add remaining 2 cup coconut milk and 1 tsp cardamom powder. Add 1/4 cup raisins and fry for 1 minute until swollen. Step 6: Mix the fried nuts and raisins into the pradhaman and rest for 10 minutes before serving.

title: kuzhalappam
instructions: Step 1: Heat 1 cup water in a pan on medium flame for 3 minutes. Add 1 tsp salt,1 tbsp sugar,and 3 tbsp coconut oil. Bring it to a gentle boil for 1 minute. Step 3: Mix 1 cup coconut,1 tsp cumin seeds,and 1 tbsp sesame seeds in a bowl. Step 4: Roll the dough into thin sheets and cut into long strips. Spread 1 tbsp coconut filling along each strip and roll tightly into cylindrical spirals. Step 5: Heat a shallow pan on medium flame for 2 minutes. Place the rolls in the pan and toast for 3 minutes on each side with 1 tbsp coconut oil until light golden and crisp. Step 6: Cool for 5 minutes before serving.

title: rajma masala

Step 5: Add the spinach puree,2 tsp salt,and 1 cup water. Simmer on low flame for 6 minutes until the gravy becomes smooth and slightly thick. title: baingan bharta

title: vellarikka pachadi

title: chicken keema curry

title: chole
instructions: Step 1: Wash 2 cup chickpeas thoroughly and soak in 6 cup water for 8 hours.
