title: gajar halwa
instructions: Step 1: Wash and peel 4 cup carrot,then grate it finely. Step 2: Heat 2 tbsp ghee in a heavy pan on medium flame for 1 minute. Add the grated carrot and saute for 6 minutes until it turns slightly soft and glossy. Step 3: Add 2 liter milk and cook on medium flame for 20 minutes while stirring every 2 minutes until the milk reduces and the carrot becomes soft. Step 4: Add 1.5 cup sugar and cook on low flame for 12 minutes while stirring continuously until the mixture thickens. Step 5: Add 1 tsp cardamom powder and remaining 2 tbsp ghee. Mix for 2 minutes until the halwa leaves the sides of the pan. Step 6: Heat a small pan on medium flame for 1 minute. Add 1/2 cup cashew nuts and fry for 2 minutes until golden. Add 1/4 cup raisins and fry for 1 minute until swollen. Step 7: Mix the nuts and raisins into the halwa and rest for 5 minutes before serving warm.

title: phulka
instructions: Step 1: Mix 3 cup whole wheat flour and 1 tsp salt in a bowl. Add 1 cup water gradually and knead for 8 minutes until a soft smooth dough forms. Step 2: Apply 1 tbsp oil over the dough,cover it,and rest for 20 minutes so it becomes elastic. Step 3: Divide the dough into equal balls and roll each ball into a thin round disc using a rolling pin. Step 4: Heat a tawa on medium flame for 3 minutes. Place one rolled disc on the tawa and cook for 30 seconds until small bubbles appear. Turn it and cook for 20 seconds until light brown spots appear. Step 5: Lift the phulka with tongs and place it directly over a medium flame for 10 seconds until it puffs up. Step 6: Remove and repeat with the remaining dough balls. Serve hot.

title: masala chai
instructions: Step 1: Crush 3 number cardamom lightly and grate 1 tbsp ginger. Step 2: Add 2 cup water,2 tsp tea powder,cardamom,and ginger to a saucepan and boil on high flame for 4 minutes until the liquid turns dark and aromatic. Step 3: Add 1 cup milk and 2 tbsp sugar,then reduce to medium flame and simmer for 3 minutes until the chai becomes frothy and slightly reduced. Step 4: Strain into cups immediately while hot. Step 5: Rest for 1 minute before serving.

title: badam milk
instructions: Step 1: Soak 1/4 cup almonds in warm water for 10 minutes,peel them,and grind into a smooth paste with 2 tbsp milk. Step 2: Heat 2 cup milk in a saucepan on medium flame for 6 minutes until hot but not boiling. Step 3: Add the almond paste,10 number saffron strands,crushed 3 number cardamom,and 3 tbsp sugar. Simmer on low flame for 5 minutes while stirring until the milk becomes slightly thick and fragrant. Step 4: Turn off the flame and cool for 2 minutes. Step 5: Serve warm or chilled.

title: mango lassi
instructions: Step 1: Peel 2 cup mango and cut the flesh into pieces. Crush 2 number cardamom lightly. Step 2: Add mango,2 cup yogurt,1 cup milk,3 tbsp sugar,and cardamom into a blender. Blend for 2 minutes until smooth and frothy. Step 3: Taste and blend for 30 more seconds if the texture needs to be more even. Step 4: Pour into glasses and chill for 10 minutes before serving cold.

title: fruit custard
instructions: Step 1: Mix 2 tbsp custard powder with 1/4 cup cold milk in a bowl until no lumps remain. Step 2: Heat 2 cup milk in a saucepan on medium flame for 5 minutes until hot. Add 4 tbsp sugar and crushed 2 number cardamom,then stir for 1 minute. Step 3: Add the custard slurry slowly while stirring continuously. Cook on low flame for 4 minutes until the mixture thickens and coats the spoon. Step 4: Turn off the flame and cool for 15 minutes. Step 5: Add 1 cup apple,1 cup banana,1 cup grapes,and 1 cup pomegranate. Mix gently and chill for 30 minutes before serving.

title: bread pudding
instructions: Step 1: Cut 6 number bread into small pieces and place them in a greased baking dish. Step 2: Beat 2 number egg with 1/2 cup sugar and crushed 2 number cardamom for 2 minutes until smooth. Step 3: Add 2 cup milk and whisk for 1 minute until the mixture is evenly combined. Step 4: Pour the milk mixture over the bread and press lightly so the bread absorbs the liquid. Rest for 10 minutes. Step 5: Sprinkle 1/4 cup raisins on top and dot with 3 tbsp butter. Step 6: Bake in a preheated oven at medium heat for 25 minutes until the top turns golden and the custard is set. Step 7: Cool for 10 minutes before serving warm.

title: banana pancakes
instructions: Step 1: Mash 2 number banana in a bowl until smooth. Add 1 number egg,1 cup milk,2 tbsp sugar,1 cup maida,and 1 tsp baking powder. Whisk for 2 minutes until a smooth batter forms. Step 2: Rest the batter for 10 minutes so it becomes airy. Step 3: Heat a tawa on medium flame for 2 minutes and add 1 tsp butter. Step 4: Pour 1 ladle batter onto the tawa and cook on low-medium flame for 2 minutes until bubbles appear on top and the bottom turns golden. Step 5: Flip and cook for 1 minute until the other side is also golden and the pancake is cooked through. Step 6: Repeat with the remaining batter and serve warm.

title: paneer tacos
instructions: Step 1: Mix 2 cup maida,1 tsp salt,1 tbsp oil,and 1 cup water into a soft dough. Knead for 8 minutes and rest for 20 minutes. Step 2: Divide the dough into small balls and roll each into a thin round disc. Cook each disc on a hot tawa on medium flame for 1 minute on each side until light brown spots appear. Step 3: Cut 300 g paneer into small cubes. Heat 2 tbsp oil in a pan on medium flame for 1 minute. Add 1 cup onion,1 cup capsicum,2 number green chilli,and 1 cup tomato. Saute for 4 minutes until slightly soft. Step 4: Add paneer,1 tsp cumin powder,1 tsp chilli powder,and 2 tsp salt. Cook on low flame for 3 minutes until the mixture is dry but well coated. Step 5: Fill each taco shell with the paneer mixture and 1 cup yogurt. Step 6: Serve immediately while warm.

title: garlic bread
instructions: Step 1: Mix 4 tbsp butter,2 tbsp finely crushed garlic,2 tbsp parsley,1 tsp oregano,and 1/2 tsp salt in a bowl for 1 minute until well combined. Step 2: Slice 4 number bread horizontally and spread the garlic butter evenly on each cut surface. Step 3: Arrange the bread on a baking tray and bake in a preheated oven on medium heat for 10 minutes until the edges turn golden and crisp. Step 4: For extra color, broil for 1 minute if needed until the top becomes lightly browned. Step 5: Rest for 2 minutes before serving warm.

title: spaghetti aglio e olio
instructions: Step 1: Boil 5 cup water in a large pot on high flame for 5 minutes. Add 2 tsp salt and 300 g spaghetti. Cook on medium flame for 10 minutes until soft but firm. Drain and keep 1/2 cup of the cooking water aside. Step 2: Heat 4 tbsp olive oil in a pan on low flame for 1 minute. Add 2 tbsp sliced garlic and cook for 1 minute until light golden,not brown. Step 3: Add 1 tsp chilli flakes and stir for 20 seconds until aromatic. Step 4: Add the cooked spaghetti and 1/2 cup reserved water. Toss on medium flame for 2 minutes until the pasta is glossy and evenly coated. Step 5: Add 2 tbsp parsley and toss for 30 seconds. Step 6: Rest for 1 minute before serving hot.

title: paneer quesadilla
instructions: Step 1: Mix 2 cup maida,1 tsp salt,1 tbsp oil,and 1 cup water into a soft dough. Knead for 8 minutes and rest for 20 minutes. Step 2: Cut 300 g paneer into small cubes and mix with 1 cup onion,1 cup capsicum,1 cup corn,2 number green chilli,and 1 tsp salt. Step 3: Divide the dough into equal balls and roll into thin round tortillas. Cook each tortilla on a hot tawa on medium flame for 1 minute on each side until just cooked. Step 4: Place 2 tbsp paneer mixture and 2 tbsp cheese on one half of each tortilla,then fold into a semicircle. Step 5: Heat 2 tbsp butter and 2 tbsp oil on a tawa on medium flame for 1 minute. Cook each quesadilla for 2 minutes on each side until golden brown and the cheese melts fully. Step 6: Rest for 1 minute before cutting and serving hot.

title: hot chocolate
instructions: Step 1: Add 2 tbsp cocoa powder,3 tbsp sugar,and 0.25 tsp salt into a saucepan. Step 2: Pour in 1/2 cup milk and whisk for 2 minutes on low flame until the mixture becomes smooth and lump free. Step 3: Add the remaining 1.5 cup milk and 1 tbsp butter,then cook on medium flame for 5 minutes while stirring continuously until the drink becomes hot and slightly thick. Step 4: Add 1 tsp vanilla essence and cook on low flame for 1 minute until aromatic. Step 5: Turn off the flame and pour into cups immediately while hot.

title: rose falooda
instructions: Step 1: Soak 2 tbsp basil seeds in 1 cup water for 10 minutes until they swell fully. Step 2: Boil 1 cup water in a pan on high flame for 3 minutes,add 1/2 cup vermicelli,and cook on medium flame for 4 minutes until soft. Drain and cool for 5 minutes. Step 3: Heat 2 cup milk in a saucepan on medium flame for 5 minutes until hot. Add 2 tbsp sugar and stir for 1 minute until dissolved. Cool the milk for 5 minutes. Step 4: In two serving glasses add 2 tbsp rose syrup each,then add the soaked basil seeds and cooked vermicelli evenly. Step 5: Pour the cooled milk into the glasses and top each glass with 1 number ice cream. Step 6: Serve immediately while cold.

title: chocolate pudding
instructions: Step 1: Mix 2 tbsp corn flour with 1/2 cup cold milk in a bowl until smooth and lump free. Step 2: Heat the remaining 1.5 cup milk in a saucepan on medium flame for 4 minutes until hot. Add 2 tbsp cocoa powder,4 tbsp sugar,and 0.25 tsp salt. Stir for 1 minute until dissolved. Step 3: Add the corn flour slurry slowly while stirring continuously. Cook on low flame for 4 minutes until the mixture thickens and coats the spoon. Step 4: Add 1 tbsp butter and 1/4 cup chocolate chips. Stir on low flame for 1 minute until the chips melt completely and the pudding becomes glossy. Step 5: Pour into cups and cool for 15 minutes. Step 6: Chill for 30 minutes before serving.

title: french toast
instructions: Step 1: Beat 2 number egg with 1/2 cup milk,2 tbsp sugar,1/2 tsp cardamom powder,and 0.25 tsp salt in a bowl for 2 minutes until well combined. Step 2: Dip 4 number bread slices into the mixture for 10 seconds on each side so they absorb the liquid without breaking. Step 3: Heat 1 tbsp butter in a pan on medium flame for 1 minute. Place the soaked bread slices in the pan and cook for 2 minutes on each side until golden brown and cooked through. Step 4: Add the remaining 1 tbsp butter and cook the last side for 1 minute if needed until crisp at the edges. Step 5: Rest for 1 minute and serve hot.

title: hummus
instructions: Step 1: Soak 2 cup chickpeas in 6 cup water for 8 hours. Drain and pressure cook with 4 cup water and 1 tsp salt on high flame for 1 whistle,then on low flame for 20 minutes until very soft. Drain and keep 1 cup cooking liquid aside. Step 2: Add the cooked chickpeas,1/4 cup tahini,3 tbsp lemon juice,2 tbsp garlic,1 tsp cumin seeds,2 tbsp olive oil,and 1/2 cup reserved cooking liquid into a mixer. Step 3: Blend for 2 minutes,then stop and scrape down the sides. Blend again for 2 minutes until the hummus becomes smooth and creamy. Step 4: Add the remaining reserved cooking liquid a little at a time if needed and blend for 1 minute until the texture is soft and spreadable. Step 5: Transfer to a bowl and rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: falafel
instructions: Step 1: Soak 2 cup chickpeas in 6 cup water for 8 hours. Drain well and pat dry. Step 2: Add the chickpeas,1 cup onion,2 tbsp garlic,1/4 cup parsley,1 tsp cumin seeds,1 tsp coriander powder,1 tsp chilli powder,1/2 tsp baking powder,1/4 cup besan,and 1 tsp salt into a mixer. Pulse for 2 minutes until the mixture becomes coarse and holds together when pressed. Step 3: Rest the mixture for 15 minutes so it firms up. Step 4: Heat 500 ml oil in a deep kadai on medium flame for 8 minutes until hot. Shape the mixture into small balls or patties and fry in batches for 4 minutes on each side until deep golden brown and crisp. Step 5: Drain for 2 minutes before serving hot.

title: shakshuka
instructions: Step 1: Heat 3 tbsp oil in a wide pan on medium flame for 1 minute. Add 1 cup onion,2 number green chilli,and 1 tbsp garlic. Saute for 5 minutes until the onion becomes soft. Step 2: Add 3 cup tomato,1 tsp cumin powder,1 tsp paprika,and 2 tsp salt. Cook on medium flame for 8 minutes until the tomato breaks down and the sauce becomes thick. Step 3: Add 1 cup water and simmer on low flame for 3 minutes until the sauce looks glossy and slightly loose. Step 4: Make 4 small wells in the sauce and crack 4 number egg into them carefully. Cover and cook on low flame for 5 minutes until the egg whites set and the yolks remain soft or cook for 2 more minutes for firmer yolks. Step 5: Rest for 2 minutes before serving hot.

title: mac and cheese
instructions: Step 1: Boil 5 cup water in a large pot on high flame for 5 minutes. Add 1 tsp salt and 2 cup macaroni,then cook on medium flame for 8 minutes until soft but firm. Drain and keep aside. Step 2: Heat 2 tbsp butter in a saucepan on medium flame for 1 minute. Add 2 tbsp maida and cook for 1 minute while stirring until the raw flour smell disappears. Step 3: Add 2 cup milk slowly while whisking continuously for 3 minutes until the sauce becomes smooth and slightly thick. Step 4: Add 1.5 cup cheese,1 tsp black pepper,and remaining 1 tsp salt. Cook on low flame for 2 minutes until the cheese melts completely and the sauce becomes creamy. Step 5: Add the cooked macaroni and mix for 2 minutes on low flame until each piece is coated. Step 6: Rest for 2 minutes before serving hot.

title: mushroom soup
instructions: Step 1: Wash 500 g mushroom thoroughly and slice evenly. Step 2: Heat 2 tbsp butter in a pan on medium flame for 1 minute. Add 1 cup onion and 1 tbsp garlic. Saute for 4 minutes until the onion turns soft. Step 3: Add the mushrooms and cook on medium flame for 6 minutes until they release water and start shrinking. Step 4: Add 2 tbsp maida and cook on low flame for 1 minute while stirring until the raw flour smell disappears. Step 5: Add 3 cup water and boil on medium flame for 5 minutes until the soup starts thickening. Step 6: Add 2 cup milk,1 tsp black pepper,and 1 tsp salt. Simmer on low flame for 4 minutes without boiling heavily until the soup becomes smooth and creamy. Step 7: Rest for 2 minutes before serving hot.

title: pita bread
instructions: Step 1: Mix 3 cup maida,1 tsp yeast,1 tsp sugar,and 1 tsp salt in a bowl. Add 2 tbsp oil and 1 cup lukewarm water slowly. Knead for 10 minutes until a soft smooth dough forms. Step 2: Cover the dough and rest for 1 hour until it doubles in size. Step 3: Divide the dough into equal balls and roll each ball into a thin round disc. Step 4: Heat a tawa on high flame for 3 minutes. Place one disc on the hot tawa and cook for 1 minute until bubbles appear. Flip and cook for 1 minute until light brown spots form. Step 5: Remove the bread and keep it covered so it stays soft. Repeat with the remaining dough. Step 6: Rest for 2 minutes before serving warm.

title: tiramisu cup
instructions: Step 1: Brew 1 cup strong coffee and cool it for 5 minutes until just lukewarm. Step 2: Whisk 1 cup cream,1 cup mascarpone,and 3 tbsp sugar in a bowl for 3 minutes until smooth and slightly fluffy. Step 3: Dip 12 number biscuits quickly into the coffee for 2 seconds on each side so they soften without breaking. Step 4: Place a layer of soaked biscuits in serving cups,add a layer of the cream mixture,then repeat for a second layer. Step 5: Dust the top with 2 tbsp cocoa powder using a fine sieve. Step 6: Chill for 30 minutes before serving cold.

title: mango mousse
instructions: Step 1: Peel 2 cup mango and blend into a smooth puree for 2 minutes. Step 2: Add 1 tbsp gelatin to 1/4 cup warm water and rest for 5 minutes until softened. Step 3: Heat 1/2 cup milk on low flame for 2 minutes until warm. Add the gelatin mixture and stir for 1 minute until fully dissolved. Cool for 5 minutes. Step 4: Whisk 1 cup cream and 3 tbsp sugar for 3 minutes until slightly thick. Add the mango puree and cooled gelatin milk mixture,then whisk for 1 minute until smooth. Step 5: Pour into serving cups and chill for 2 hours until set and creamy. Step 6: Serve cold.

title: oreo milkshake
instructions: Step 1: Break 10 number oreo biscuits into small pieces and keep 2 tbsp chocolate syrup ready for serving. Step 2: Add the biscuit pieces,2 cup chilled milk,2 number ice cream,2 tbsp sugar,and 1 tbsp chocolate syrup into a blender jar. Step 3: Blend on medium speed for 30 seconds,then blend on high speed for 60 to 90 seconds until the shake becomes thick,smooth,and frothy with no large biscuit pieces left. Step 4: Taste the milkshake and add a little more sugar only if needed,then blend for another 10 seconds. Step 5: Drizzle the remaining chocolate syrup inside two chilled glasses,pour the milkshake immediately,and serve cold before the froth settles.

title: mojito
instructions: Step 1: Cut 2 number lemon into wedges and place them in a large jug with 3 tbsp sugar and 1/2 cup mint leaves. Step 2: Crush the mixture gently using a muddler or spoon for 2 minutes until the lemon releases juice and the mint becomes aromatic. Step 3: Add 1 cup ice cubes and 1/2 cup chilled water,then stir for 30 seconds until the sugar starts dissolving. Step 4: Pour in 2 cup soda water slowly and mix gently for 20 seconds without losing the fizz. Step 5: Serve immediately while cold.

title: waffles
instructions: Step 1: Beat 2 number egg and 3 tbsp sugar in a bowl for 2 minutes until slightly fluffy. Step 2: Add 1.5 cup milk,4 tbsp melted butter,and 1 tsp vanilla essence. Mix for 1 minute until combined. Step 3: Add 2 cup maida,1 tsp baking powder,and 0.25 tsp salt. Whisk for 2 minutes until a smooth batter forms without lumps. Rest for 10 minutes. Step 4: Heat a waffle maker on medium heat for 3 minutes and grease lightly with butter. Step 5: Pour enough batter to cover the waffle plate and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until golden brown and crisp outside. Step 6: Remove carefully and repeat with the remaining batter. Serve warm.

title: nachos
instructions: Step 1: Mix 1 cup maida,1 cup corn flour,1 tsp chilli powder,1 tsp oregano,and 1 tsp salt in a bowl. Add 3/4 cup water slowly and knead for 8 minutes until a firm dough forms. Step 2: Cover and rest the dough for 15 minutes. Step 3: Roll the dough into thin sheets and cut into small triangles. Step 4: Heat 500 ml oil in a deep kadai on medium flame for 8 minutes until hot. Fry the triangles in batches for 3 minutes until crisp and light golden. Step 5: Drain for 2 minutes and cool slightly before serving.

title: veg lasagna
instructions: Step 1: Boil 5 cup water in a large pot on high flame for 5 minutes. Add 1 tsp salt and cook 10 number lasagna sheets on medium flame for 8 minutes until soft but firm. Drain and keep aside. Step 2: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a pan on medium flame for 1 minute. Add 1 cup onion,1 cup capsicum,1 cup mushroom,and 1 cup carrot. Saute for 6 minutes until slightly soft. Step 3: Add 2 cup tomato,1 tsp oregano,and remaining 1 tsp salt. Cook on medium flame for 8 minutes until thick and saucy. Step 4: Heat 3 tbsp butter in another pan on medium flame for 1 minute. Add 2 tbsp maida and cook for 1 minute. Add 2 cup milk slowly while whisking continuously for 3 minutes until a smooth white sauce forms. Step 5: Grease a baking dish and spread a thin layer of vegetable sauce. Place lasagna sheets over it,spread white sauce,and sprinkle cheese. Repeat the layers until all ingredients are used. Step 6: Bake in a preheated oven on medium heat for 25 minutes until the cheese melts and the top turns golden. Step 7: Rest for 10 minutes before cutting and serving hot.

title: falooda ice cream
instructions: Step 1: Soak 2 tbsp basil seeds in 1 cup water for 10 minutes until swollen. Step 2: Boil 2 cup water in a pan on high flame for 4 minutes. Add 1 cup falooda sev and cook on medium flame for 4 minutes until soft. Drain and cool for 5 minutes. Step 3: Heat 2 cup milk on medium flame for 5 minutes until hot. Add 2 tbsp sugar and stir for 1 minute until dissolved. Cool completely for 10 minutes. Step 4: Add 2 tbsp rose syrup into each serving glass,then layer soaked basil seeds and cooked falooda sev evenly. Step 5: Pour the cooled milk into the glasses and top each with 1 number ice cream. Step 6: Serve immediately while cold.

title: stuffed garlic bread
instructions: Step 1: Mix 3 cup maida,1 tsp yeast,1 tsp sugar,and 1 tsp salt in a bowl. Add 1 cup lukewarm water slowly and knead for 10 minutes until a soft dough forms. Cover and rest for 1 hour until doubled in size. Step 2: Mix 4 tbsp butter,2 tbsp garlic,and 1 tsp oregano in a bowl until evenly combined. Step 3: Roll the dough into a thick rectangle and spread the garlic butter mixture evenly. Sprinkle 2 cup cheese over one half and fold the dough over to seal. Step 4: Place on a baking tray and rest for 10 minutes. Step 5: Bake in a preheated oven on medium heat for 20 minutes until the bread turns golden brown and the cheese melts completely. Step 6: Cool for 5 minutes before slicing and serving warm.

title: veg sushi rolls
instructions: Step 1: Wash 2 cup sushi rice in water 3 times until the water becomes clear. Cook it with 4 cup water on medium flame for 15 minutes until soft and sticky. Cool for 10 minutes. Step 2: Mix 2 tbsp rice vinegar,1 tbsp sugar,and 1 tsp salt in a bowl until dissolved. Fold this mixture gently into the cooled rice for 2 minutes. Step 3: Cut 1 cup cucumber,1 cup carrot,and 1 cup avocado into thin long strips. Step 4: Place 1 nori sheet on a bamboo mat and spread a thin layer of rice evenly,leaving 1 inch space at the top edge. Arrange vegetable strips in the center. Step 5: Roll tightly using the mat while pressing gently to keep the roll compact. Seal the edge with a little water. Step 6: Cut each roll into equal pieces using a sharp wet knife and serve immediately.

title: brownies
instructions: Step 1: Melt 1/2 cup butter on low flame for 2 minutes until fully liquid. Cool for 2 minutes. Step 2: Beat 2 number egg and 1 cup sugar in a bowl for 3 minutes until smooth and slightly fluffy. Add melted butter and 1 tsp vanilla essence,then whisk for 1 minute. Step 3: Add 1 cup maida,1/2 cup cocoa powder,and 0.25 tsp salt. Fold gently for 2 minutes until no dry flour remains. Add 1/2 cup chocolate chips and mix lightly. Step 4: Pour the batter into a greased baking tray and spread evenly. Step 5: Bake in a preheated oven on medium heat for 25 minutes until the top sets and a toothpick inserted comes out with a few moist crumbs. Step 6: Cool for 15 minutes before cutting into pieces and serving.

title: medu vada
instructions: Step 1: Wash 2 cup urad dal thoroughly and soak in 4 cup water for 4 hours. Drain completely. Step 2: Grind the soaked urad dal with 1/4 cup water for 6 minutes until the batter becomes thick,fluffy,and smooth. Step 3: Add 1 cup onion,3 number green chilli,1 tbsp ginger,1 tbsp curry leaves,1 tsp cumin seeds,and 1 tsp salt. Mix for 2 minutes and rest for 10 minutes so the batter firms up slightly. Step 4: Heat 500 ml oil in a deep kadai on medium flame for 8 minutes until hot. Wet your hands lightly,shape the batter into small rounds with a hole in the center,and slide them carefully into the oil. Step 5: Fry on medium flame for 3 minutes on each side until the vadas turn deep golden brown and crisp. Step 6: Drain for 2 minutes before serving hot.

title: onion pakora
instructions: Step 1: Slice 3 cup onion into thin pieces and place them in a large bowl. Add 3 number green chilli,1 tbsp curry leaves,1 tsp ajwain,and 1 tsp salt. Mix for 1 minute and rest for 5 minutes until the onion releases moisture. Step 2: Add 1 cup besan and 1/2 cup rice flour. Sprinkle 1/2 cup water slowly while mixing for 2 minutes until the onions bind into a thick mixture. Step 3: Heat 500 ml oil in a deep kadai on medium flame for 8 minutes until hot. Drop small portions of the batter into the oil and fry on medium flame for 4 minutes,turning once,until the pakoras turn deep golden brown and crisp. Step 4: Drain for 2 minutes before serving hot.

title: kuzhi paniyaram
instructions: Step 1: Mix 3 cup idli batter with 1 cup onion,2 number green chilli,1 tbsp curry leaves,1 tsp cumin seeds,and 1 tsp salt in a bowl for 1 minute until evenly combined. Step 2: Heat a paniyaram pan on medium flame for 2 minutes and add a few drops of oil into each cavity. Step 3: Fill each cavity three-fourths full with batter. Cover and cook on low flame for 3 minutes until the bottoms turn golden and the tops begin to set. Step 4: Turn each paniyaram carefully using a spoon or skewer and cook for 2 more minutes until both sides are evenly browned and cooked through. Step 5: Remove and serve hot.

title: veg puff
instructions: Step 1: Mix 3 cup maida,2 tbsp oil,and 1 tsp salt in a bowl. Add 1 cup water slowly and knead for 8 minutes until a soft dough forms. Cover and rest for 20 minutes. Step 2: Wash and peel 2 cup potato and 1 cup carrot,then cut them into small cubes. Step 3: Boil the potato,carrot,and 1 cup green peas in 3 cup water on medium flame for 10 minutes until just soft. Drain and mash lightly. Step 4: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a pan on medium flame for 1 minute. Add 1 cup onion and 1 tbsp ginger,then saute for 4 minutes until soft. Add the mashed vegetables,1 tsp garam masala,and 2 tsp salt. Cook on low flame for 5 minutes until the filling becomes dry. Cool for 10 minutes. Step 5: Roll the dough into thin squares,place 2 tbsp filling in the center of each,fold into triangle parcels,and seal the edges. Step 6: Bake on a greased tray in a preheated oven on medium heat for 20 minutes until the puffs turn golden brown. Step 7: Rest for 5 minutes before serving warm.

title: egg puff
instructions: Step 1: Mix 3 cup maida,2 tbsp oil,and 1 tsp salt in a bowl. Add 1 cup water slowly and knead for 8 minutes until a smooth dough forms. Cover and rest for 20 minutes. Step 2: Boil 4 number egg in 2 cup water on medium flame for 12 minutes until fully cooked. Cool for 5 minutes,peel,and keep aside. Step 3: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a pan on medium flame for 1 minute. Add 1 cup onion,2 number green chilli,and 1 tbsp ginger,then saute for 5 minutes until soft. Add 1 tsp garam masala and 1 tsp salt,then cook for 1 minute. Step 4: Divide the dough into equal squares and roll each into thin sheets. Place one boiled egg in the center of each sheet and top with the onion masala. Fold the dough tightly around the egg and seal the edges. Step 5: Place the parcels on a greased tray and bake in a preheated oven on medium heat for 20 minutes until the crust turns golden brown. Step 6: Rest for 5 minutes before serving warm.

title: chakka cutlet
instructions: Step 1: Peel 2 cup raw jackfruit and cut into small pieces. Pressure cook it with 3 cup water on high flame for 1 whistle and then on low flame for 10 minutes until soft. Drain and mash lightly. Step 2: Boil 1 cup potato in 2 cup water on medium flame for 15 minutes until soft. Peel and mash it. Step 3: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a pan on medium flame for 1 minute. Add 1 cup onion,2 number green chilli,and 1 tbsp ginger,then saute for 4 minutes until soft. Step 4: Mix the jackfruit mash,potato mash,sauteed onion mixture,1 tsp black pepper,and 1 tsp salt in a bowl. Cook on low flame for 3 minutes until the mixture becomes dry and easy to shape. Cool for 10 minutes. Step 5: Shape into cutlets and coat each one with 2 cup breadcrumbs. Step 6: Heat 500 ml oil in a deep kadai on medium flame for 8 minutes until hot. Fry the cutlets in batches for 4 minutes on each side until golden brown and crisp. Step 7: Drain for 2 minutes before serving hot.

title: bread omelette
instructions: Step 1: Crack 3 number egg into a bowl. Add 1 tsp salt and 1 tsp black pepper,then beat for 2 minutes until fully mixed. Step 2: Add 1 cup onion,1 cup tomato,2 number green chilli,and 1/4 cup coriander leaves to the egg mixture and stir for 1 minute. Step 3: Heat 1 tbsp butter in a pan on medium flame for 1 minute. Place 2 number bread slices in the pan and pour half the egg mixture over them. Cook on medium flame for 3 minutes until the bottom turns golden and the egg starts setting. Step 4: Flip carefully,add a little more butter if needed,and cook for 2 more minutes until the egg is fully cooked and the bread is crisp. Step 5: Repeat with the remaining bread slices and egg mixture. Step 6: Rest for 1 minute before serving hot.

title: kachori
instructions: Step 1: Soak 1 cup moong dal in 3 cup water for 4 hours. Drain and grind it coarsely with 1 tsp cumin seeds,1 tsp fennel seeds,1 tsp chilli powder,and 1 tsp salt. Step 2: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a pan on medium flame for 1 minute. Add 1 cup onion and saute for 5 minutes until soft. Add the ground dal mixture and cook on low flame for 5 minutes until the filling becomes dry. Cool for 10 minutes. Step 3: Mix 3 cup maida,1 tsp salt,and 2 tbsp oil in a bowl. Add 1 cup water slowly and knead for 8 minutes until a firm dough forms. Rest for 20 minutes. Step 4: Divide the dough into balls,flatten each one,place 1 tbsp filling in the center,and seal into smooth rounds. Step 5: Heat 500 ml oil in a deep kadai on medium flame for 8 minutes until hot. Fry the kachoris on low-medium flame for 6 minutes until deep golden brown and crisp. Step 6: Drain for 2 minutes before serving hot.

title: masala peanuts
instructions: Step 1: Mix 1 cup besan,1/2 cup rice flour,1 tsp chilli powder,1/2 tsp turmeric powder,and 1 tsp salt in a bowl. Add 1 cup water slowly and whisk for 2 minutes until a thick coating batter forms. Step 2: Add 2 cup peanuts and 1 tbsp curry leaves to the batter and mix for 1 minute until every peanut is coated. Step 3: Heat 500 ml oil in a deep kadai on medium flame for 8 minutes until hot. Drop small clusters of the coated peanuts into the oil and fry on medium flame for 4 minutes until crisp and golden brown. Step 4: Drain for 2 minutes and cool slightly before serving.

title: stuffed paratha
instructions: Step 1: Mix 3 cup whole wheat flour,1 tsp salt,and 1 tbsp oil in a bowl. Add 1 cup water slowly and knead for 8 minutes until a soft dough forms. Cover and rest for 20 minutes. Step 2: Boil 2 cup potato in 3 cup water on medium flame for 15 minutes until soft. Peel and mash it. Step 3: Mix the mashed potato with 1 cup onion,2 number green chilli,1 tbsp ginger,1/4 cup coriander leaves,1 tsp cumin powder,and 1 tsp salt. Rest for 5 minutes. Step 4: Divide the dough into balls,roll each into a small disc,place 2 tbsp filling in the center,and seal it into a ball again. Step 5: Roll each stuffed ball gently into a paratha. Step 6: Heat a tawa on medium flame for 2 minutes. Cook each paratha for 2 minutes on one side,flip,and cook for 2 minutes on the other side while applying remaining oil until golden brown spots appear. Step 7: Serve hot.

title: corn cheese balls
instructions: Step 1: Boil 2 cup potato in 3 cup water on medium flame for 15 minutes until soft. Peel and mash completely. Step 2: Boil 2 cup sweet corn in 2 cup water on medium flame for 6 minutes until tender. Drain fully and crush lightly. Step 3: Mix the mashed potato,crushed corn,1 cup cheese,1 tsp black pepper,2 tbsp corn flour,and 1 tsp salt in a bowl for 2 minutes until the mixture becomes firm enough to shape. Step 4: Shape into small balls and coat each ball evenly with 2 cup breadcrumbs. Rest for 10 minutes so the coating sets properly. Step 5: Heat 500 ml oil in a deep kadai on medium flame for 8 minutes until hot. Fry the balls in batches for 4 minutes until deep golden brown and crisp outside. Step 6: Drain for 2 minutes before serving hot.

title: chicken samosa
instructions: Step 1: Mix 3 cup maida,1 tsp salt,and 2 tbsp oil in a bowl. Add 1 cup water slowly and knead for 8 minutes until a firm dough forms. Cover and rest for 20 minutes. Step 2: Wash 300 g chicken thoroughly and mince it finely. Step 3: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a pan on medium flame for 1 minute. Add 1 cup onion,2 number green chilli,and 1 tbsp ginger. Saute for 5 minutes until soft. Add the minced chicken,1 tsp garam masala,and remaining salt. Cook on medium flame for 10 minutes until fully cooked and dry. Cool for 10 minutes. Step 4: Roll the dough into thin circles and cut each into halves. Shape each half into a cone,fill with 2 tbsp chicken mixture,and seal the edges with water. Step 5: Heat 500 ml oil in a deep kadai on medium flame for 8 minutes until hot. Fry the samosas on low-medium flame for 6 minutes until deep golden brown and crisp. Step 6: Drain for 2 minutes before serving hot.

title: spring potato wedges
instructions: Step 1: Wash 4 cup potato thoroughly and cut into thick wedges without peeling. Soak them in 4 cup water for 15 minutes to remove excess starch,then drain completely. Step 2: Mix 1/2 cup maida,1 tsp chilli powder,1 tsp oregano,1 tsp black pepper,and 2 tsp salt in a bowl. Coat the potato wedges evenly with the dry mixture. Step 3: Heat 500 ml oil in a deep kadai on medium flame for 8 minutes until hot. Fry the wedges in batches for 5 minutes until light golden and cooked through. Step 4: Increase the flame to high and fry the wedges again for 1 minute until crisp outside and fluffy inside. Step 5: Drain for 2 minutes before serving hot.

title: egg sandwich
instructions: Step 1: Boil 4 number egg in 3 cup water on medium flame for 12 minutes until fully cooked. Cool for 5 minutes,peel,and mash completely. Step 2: Mix the mashed egg with 1 cup onion,2 number green chilli,1/2 cup mayonnaise,1 tsp black pepper,and 1 tsp salt for 2 minutes until evenly combined. Step 3: Heat 2 tbsp butter on a tawa on medium flame for 1 minute. Toast 6 number bread slices for 1 minute on each side until lightly crisp. Step 4: Spread the egg mixture evenly over 3 bread slices and cover with the remaining slices. Step 5: Cut each sandwich into halves and serve immediately while warm.

instructions: Step 1: Wash 2 cup chickpeas thoroughly and soak them in 6 cup water for 8 hours. Drain and pressure cook with 3 cup fresh water and 1 tsp salt on high flame for 1 whistle,then on low flame for 15 minutes until soft but not mushy. Step 2: Heat 2 tbsp coconut oil in a pan on medium flame for 1 minute. Add 1 tsp mustard seeds and cook for 30 seconds until they crackle. Add 1 tbsp curry leaves,1 cup onion,and 3 number green chilli,then saute for 4 minutes until the onion turns soft and light golden. Step 3: Add the cooked chickpeas and stir on medium flame for 3 minutes until the seasoning coats them evenly. Step 4: Add 1 cup coconut and 1 tsp salt,then cook on low flame for 2 minutes until the mixture turns dry and fragrant. Step 5: Turn off the flame,add 2 tbsp lemon juice,mix gently for 30 seconds,and rest for 2 minutes before serving warm.

instructions: Step 1: Wash 500 g chicken thoroughly and mince it finely. Step 2: Mix the minced chicken with 1 cup onion,2 number green chilli,1 tbsp ginger,1 tbsp garlic,1/4 cup coriander leaves,1 tsp garam masala,1 tsp cumin powder,1 tsp black pepper,and 1 tsp salt in a bowl for 3 minutes until the mixture becomes sticky and evenly seasoned. Step 3: Rest the mixture for 15 minutes so it firms up. Step 4: Shape the mixture into small kebabs or oval patties with lightly wet hands. Step 5: Heat 3 tbsp oil in a pan on medium flame for 1 minute. Place the kebabs carefully and cook for 4 minutes on each side until the outer surface turns golden brown and the center is fully cooked. Step 6: Reduce to low flame for 2 minutes if needed so the kebabs cook through without burning. Step 7: Rest for 2 minutes before serving hot.

instructions: Step 1: Wash 500 g mutton thoroughly and mince it very finely. Step 2: Mix the minced mutton with 1 cup onion,2 number green chilli,1 tbsp ginger,1 tbsp garlic,1/4 cup coriander leaves,1 tsp cumin powder,1 tsp garam masala,1 tsp black pepper,and 1 tsp salt. Knead the mixture for 3 minutes until it becomes compact and sticky. Step 3: Rest the mixture for 20 minutes in a cool place. Step 4: Shape the mixture around skewers into long seekh kebabs. Step 5: Heat 3 tbsp oil in a grill pan on medium flame for 1 minute. Cook the kebabs for 4 minutes on each side until browned and fully cooked. Step 6: If the center still feels soft,cook on low flame for 2 more minutes while turning gently. Step 7: Rest for 2 minutes before serving hot.

title: sweet corn chaat
ingredients: sweet corn,onion,tomato,cucumber,green chilli,lemon juice,black pepper,chaat masala,coriander leaves,salt,water
ingredient_measurements: [{"ingredient":"sweet corn","measurement":"2 cup","quantity":"","unit":"","note":""},{"ingredient":"onion","measurement":"1 cup","quantity":"","unit":"","note":""},{"ingredient":"tomato","measurement":"1 cup","quantity":"","unit":"","note":""},{"ingredient":"cucumber","measurement":"1 cup","quantity":"","unit":"","note":""},{"ingredient":"green chilli","measurement":"2 number","quantity":"","unit":"","note":""},{"ingredient":"lemon juice","measurement":"2 tbsp","quantity":"","unit":"","note":""},{"ingredient":"black pepper","measurement":"1 tsp","quantity":"","unit":"","note":""},{"ingredient":"chaat masala","measurement":"1 tsp","quantity":"","unit":"","note":""},{"ingredient":"coriander leaves","measurement":"1/4 cup","quantity":"","unit":"","note":""},{"ingredient":"salt","measurement":"1 tsp","quantity":"","unit":"","note":""},{"ingredient":"water","measurement":"3 cup","quantity":"","unit":"","note":""}]
instructions: Step 1: Boil 2 cup sweet corn in 3 cup water on medium flame for 6 minutes until tender. Drain completely and cool for 5 minutes. Step 2: Chop 1 cup onion,1 cup tomato,1 cup cucumber,and 2 number green chilli into small pieces. Step 3: Combine the sweet corn with the chopped vegetables in a bowl. Step 4: Add 2 tbsp lemon juice,1 tsp black pepper,1 tsp chaat masala,1 tsp salt,and 1/4 cup coriander leaves. Mix for 1 minute until evenly coated. Step 5: Rest for 5 minutes so the flavors combine and serve immediately at room temperature.

title: roasted makhana
instructions: Step 1: Heat 2 tbsp ghee in a wide pan on low flame for 1 minute. Add 3 cup makhana and roast for 6 minutes while stirring continuously until they turn crisp and light. Step 2: Add 1 tbsp curry leaves and roast for 1 minute until aromatic. Step 3: Add 1 tsp chilli powder,1/2 tsp turmeric powder,1 tsp black pepper,and 1 tsp salt. Mix on low flame for 2 minutes until the seasoning coats every piece evenly. Step 4: Turn off the flame and cool for 5 minutes so the makhana becomes extra crisp before serving.

title: avocado toast
instructions: Step 1: Cut 2 number avocado in half,remove the seed,and scoop out the pulp into a bowl. Mash it with a fork for 2 minutes until slightly chunky. Step 2: Add 2 tbsp lemon juice,1 tsp black pepper,and 1 tsp salt. Mix for 1 minute until evenly seasoned. Step 3: Heat 2 tbsp butter in a pan on medium flame for 1 minute. Toast 4 number bread slices for 1 minute on each side until lightly crisp and golden. Step 4: Spread the avocado mixture evenly over the toasted bread. Step 5: Rest for 1 minute before serving immediately.

title: peanut chikki
instructions: Step 1: Heat a dry pan on low flame for 4 minutes and roast 2 cup peanuts for 5 minutes until aromatic and lightly browned. Remove the skin by rubbing lightly after cooling for 5 minutes. Step 2: Heat 1.5 cup jaggery with 1/2 cup water in a heavy pan on medium flame for 6 minutes until the jaggery melts and the syrup becomes thick and bubbly. Step 3: Add 2 tbsp ghee and 1 tsp cardamom powder,then cook on low flame for 2 minutes until the syrup reaches a hard-ball stage. Step 4: Add the roasted peanuts and mix quickly for 1 minute until every peanut is coated. Step 5: Pour the mixture onto a greased plate,flatten it with a rolling pin or spatula,and cool for 15 minutes until firm. Step 6: Break into pieces and serve after it hardens fully.

title: falafel wrap
instructions: Step 1: Soak 2 cup chickpeas in 6 cup water for 8 hours. Drain well. Step 2: Grind the chickpeas with 1 cup onion,2 tbsp garlic,1/4 cup parsley,1 tsp cumin seeds,1 tsp coriander powder,1 tsp chilli powder,1/4 cup besan,and 1 tsp salt in short pulses for 2 minutes until the mixture becomes coarse and holds together. Step 3: Rest the mixture for 15 minutes. Step 4: Mix 2 cup maida with 1 cup water and knead for 8 minutes into a soft dough. Rest for 20 minutes. Roll the dough into thin circles and cook each one on a tawa on medium flame for 1 minute on each side until lightly cooked. Step 5: Shape the chickpea mixture into small patties and fry them in 4 tbsp oil on medium flame for 4 minutes on each side until crisp and golden brown. Step 6: Place the patties inside the cooked wraps,fold tightly,and serve warm.

title: pav bhaji
instructions: Step 1: Boil 2 cup potato,1 cup cauliflower,and 1 cup peas in 4 cup water on medium flame for 12 minutes until soft. Drain and mash lightly. Step 2: Heat 2 tbsp butter in a pan on medium flame for 1 minute. Add 1 cup onion,1 tbsp ginger,and 1 tbsp garlic. Saute for 5 minutes until soft. Step 3: Add 2 cup tomato and 1 cup capsicum. Cook on medium flame for 8 minutes until the tomato softens and the mixture becomes pulpy. Step 4: Add the mashed vegetables,2 tbsp pav bhaji masala,and 2 tsp salt. Mix well and cook on low flame for 10 minutes while mashing continuously until the bhaji becomes thick and uniform. Step 5: Add remaining 2 tbsp butter and 1 cup water. Simmer for 5 minutes until glossy and slightly loose. Step 6: Slice 4 number pav and toast them on a tawa with a little butter for 1 minute on each side until crisp and golden. Step 7: Serve the bhaji hot with toasted pav.

title: chicken popcorn
instructions: Step 1: Wash 500 g chicken thoroughly and cut into very small bite-sized cubes. Mix with 1 tbsp garlic,1 tsp black pepper,1 tsp chilli powder,and 1 tsp salt. Rest for 15 minutes. Step 2: Beat 2 number egg in a bowl for 1 minute. In another bowl mix 1 cup maida and 1/2 cup corn flour with 1/2 cup water to make a thick coating batter. Step 3: Dip the chicken pieces first into the batter,then into the beaten egg,then again lightly into the flour mixture so they get a rough crispy coating. Step 4: Heat 500 ml oil in a deep kadai on medium flame for 8 minutes until hot. Fry the coated chicken in batches for 4 minutes until golden brown and crisp. Step 5: Drain for 2 minutes before serving hot.

title: ven pongal
ingredients: rice,moong dal,ghee,black pepper,cumin seeds,ginger,curry leaves,cashew nuts nuts,salt,water
instructions: Step 1: Wash 1 cup rice and 1/2 cup moong dal separately in water 3 times. Roast the moong dal on low flame for 4 minutes until aromatic and light golden. Step 2: Add the rice,roasted dal,and 4 cup water into a pressure cooker with 1 tsp salt. Pressure cook on high flame for 1 whistle,then on low flame for 8 minutes until both become soft and slightly mushy. Step 3: Heat 4 tbsp ghee in a pan on medium flame for 1 minute. Add 1 tsp black pepper,1 tsp cumin seeds,1 tbsp ginger,1 tbsp curry leaves,and 1/4 cup cashew nuts. Saute for 2 minutes until the cashew nuts turn golden and the tempering smells fragrant. Step 4: Add the tempering to the cooked rice and dal mixture. Mix well and cook on low flame for 3 minutes until the pongal becomes creamy and glossy. Step 5: Rest for 2 minutes before serving hot.

title: ragi dosa

instructions: Step 1: Mix 2 cup ragi flour,1/2 cup rice flour,1 cup yogurt,1 tsp cumin seeds,and 1 tsp salt in a bowl. Add 3 cup water slowly while whisking for 3 minutes until a thin smooth batter forms. Rest the batter for 15 minutes. Step 2: Add 1 cup onion,2 number green chilli,and 1 tbsp curry leaves to the batter and mix for 1 minute. Step 3: Heat a dosa tawa on medium flame for 3 minutes. Pour 1 ladle batter from the outside toward the center to make a thin dosa. Step 4: Cook on medium flame for 2 minutes until the edges begin to lift,drizzle a little water around the edges if needed,and cook for 1 more minute until the surface is set. Step 5: Flip carefully and cook for 30 seconds on the other side. Step 6: Repeat with the remaining batter and serve hot.

title: pesarattu
instructions: Step 1: Wash 2 cup green gram and 1/4 cup rice separately in water 3 times. Soak them together in 4 cup water for 6 hours. Drain completely. Step 2: Grind the soaked green gram and rice with 1 tbsp ginger,2 number green chilli,1 tsp cumin seeds,and 1 cup water for 8 minutes until a smooth batter forms. Add 1 tsp salt and mix for 1 minute. Step 3: Rest the batter for 10 minutes. Step 4: Heat a dosa tawa on medium flame for 3 minutes. Pour 1 ladle batter and spread it into a thin dosa. Step 5: Cook on medium flame for 2 minutes until the bottom turns golden and the top looks dry. Flip carefully and cook for 30 seconds on the other side. Step 6: Repeat with the remaining batter and serve hot.

title: bhatura
instructions: Step 1: Mix 3 cup maida,1 cup yogurt,2 tbsp semolina,1 tsp baking powder,1 tsp sugar,and 1 tsp salt in a bowl. Add 2 tbsp oil and 1 cup water slowly. Knead for 10 minutes until a soft elastic dough forms. Step 2: Cover the dough and rest for 2 hours at room temperature until it becomes puffy and relaxed. Step 3: Divide the dough into equal balls and roll each ball into a thick oval disc. Step 4: Heat 500 ml oil in a deep kadai on medium flame for 8 minutes until hot. Slide one bhatura into the oil and press it gently so it puffs up. Fry for 1 minute on one side and 1 minute on the other side until light golden and fully puffed. Step 5: Drain for 1 minute and repeat with the remaining dough. Serve hot.

title: garlic naan
instructions: Step 1: Mix 3 cup maida,1 tsp yeast,1 tsp sugar,and 1 tsp salt in a bowl. Add 1 cup yogurt and 1 cup lukewarm water slowly. Knead for 10 minutes until a soft dough forms. Step 2: Cover and rest the dough for 1 hour until it doubles in size. Step 3: Finely crush 2 tbsp garlic and mix it with 3 tbsp melted butter. Step 4: Divide the dough into balls and roll each ball into a teardrop-shaped naan. Step 5: Heat a tawa on medium flame for 3 minutes. Place one naan on the hot tawa and cook for 1 minute until bubbles appear. Flip and cook for 1 minute until light brown spots form. Step 6: Brush the hot naan with garlic butter and cook for 20 seconds more on low flame so the garlic flavor sets in. Step 7: Repeat with the remaining dough and serve warm.

title: aloo tikki
instructions: Step 1: Boil 3 cup potato in 3 cup water on medium flame for 15 minutes until soft. Peel and mash completely. Step 2: Boil 1 cup green peas in 2 cup water on medium flame for 5 minutes until tender. Drain and crush lightly. Step 3: Mix the mashed potato,crushed peas,1 cup onion,2 number green chilli,1 tbsp ginger,2 tbsp corn flour,and 2 tsp salt in a bowl for 2 minutes until a firm mixture forms. Step 4: Shape into flat round tikkis and coat each one with 2 cup breadcrumbs. Rest for 10 minutes so the coating sets. Step 5: Heat 500 ml oil in a pan on medium flame for 8 minutes until hot. Fry the tikkis for 3 minutes on each side until golden brown and crisp. Step 6: Drain for 2 minutes before serving hot.

title: mushroom kathi roll
instructions: Step 1: Mix 2 cup maida,1 tsp salt,and 1 cup water into a soft dough. Knead for 8 minutes and rest for 20 minutes. Step 2: Wash 2 cup mushroom and slice evenly. Heat 2 tbsp oil in a pan on medium flame for 1 minute. Add 1 cup onion,1 cup capsicum,1 tbsp ginger,and 1 tbsp garlic. Saute for 4 minutes until slightly soft. Step 3: Add the mushroom,1 tsp chaat masala,and 1 tsp salt. Cook on medium flame for 6 minutes until the moisture reduces and the filling becomes dry. Step 4: Roll the dough into thin circles and cook each one on a hot tawa for 1 minute on each side until light brown spots appear. Step 5: Spread 1 tbsp yogurt over each roti,place the mushroom filling in the center,roll tightly,and toast for 1 minute on a tawa until the outside is lightly crisp. Step 6: Serve hot.

title: bread roll
instructions: Step 1: Boil 2 cup potato in 3 cup water on medium flame for 15 minutes until soft. Peel and mash completely. Step 2: Mix mashed potato,1 cup onion,2 number green chilli,1 tbsp ginger,1/4 cup coriander leaves,1 tsp black pepper,and 2 tsp salt in a bowl for 2 minutes until a thick filling forms. Step 3: Trim the edges of 8 number bread slices and flatten each slice lightly with a rolling pin. Step 4: Place 1 tbsp filling in the center of each slice,roll tightly into cylinders,and seal the edge with a little water. Step 5: Heat 500 ml oil in a deep kadai on medium flame for 8 minutes until hot. Fry the rolls on medium flame for 3 minutes until golden brown and crisp. Step 6: Drain for 2 minutes before serving hot.

title: stuffed mushrooms
instructions: Step 1: Wash 16 number mushroom and carefully remove the stems. Finely chop the stems and keep the caps aside. Step 2: Heat 2 tbsp butter in a pan on medium flame for 1 minute. Add 1 cup onion,1 tbsp garlic,and the chopped mushroom stems. Saute for 5 minutes until soft and dry. Step 3: Add 200 g crumbled paneer,1 tsp oregano,1 tsp black pepper,and 1 tsp salt. Cook on low flame for 3 minutes until the mixture becomes thick. Cool for 5 minutes. Step 4: Fill each mushroom cap with the paneer mixture and top each one with a little cheese. Step 5: Arrange them on a baking tray and bake in a preheated oven on medium heat for 12 minutes until the mushroom softens and the cheese melts. Step 6: Rest for 2 minutes before serving hot.

title: rava idli

instructions: Step 1: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a pan on low flame for 2 minutes. Add 2 cup rava and roast for 5 minutes until aromatic and slightly golden. Cool for 5 minutes. Step 2: Mix the roasted rava with 2 cup yogurt,1 cup grated carrot,2 number green chilli,1 tbsp curry leaves,1/4 cup coriander leaves,and 1 tsp salt. Add 1 cup water slowly while mixing until the batter becomes thick and spoonable. Rest for 15 minutes. Step 3: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a small pan on medium flame for 1 minute. Add 1 tsp mustard seeds and cook for 30 seconds until they crackle. Add this tempering to the batter along with 1/2 tsp baking soda and mix gently for 30 seconds. Step 4: Grease idli plates lightly and pour the batter into the moulds. Steam on medium flame for 12 minutes until the idlis are firm and spring back when touched. Step 5: Rest for 2 minutes before removing and serving hot.

instructions: Step 1: Wash 500 g seer fish and cook it in 2 cup water with 1 tsp salt and 1/2 tsp turmeric powder on medium flame for 8 minutes until fully cooked. Cool for 5 minutes and flake the fish into small pieces. Step 2: Grind 1 cup coconut,1 cup shallots,3 number green chilli,and 1 tbsp curry leaves in a mixer for 2 minutes until a coarse paste forms. Step 3: Heat 2 tbsp coconut oil in a pan on medium flame for 1 minute. Add the coconut paste and cook on low flame for 4 minutes until the raw smell disappears. Step 4: Add the flaked fish,remaining 1/2 tsp turmeric powder,and 1 tsp salt. Mix gently and cook on low flame for 3 minutes until the fish is coated evenly. Step 4: Add 2 tsp chilli powder,1 tbsp coriander powder,1 tsp black pepper,and 1 tsp salt. Cook on low flame for 2 minutes until aromatic. Step 6: Rest for 2 minutes before serving hot.

Step 2: Boil 1 cup potato in 2 cup water on medium flame for 10 minutes until just soft. Drain,peel,and cut into small cubes. Step 3: Heat 3 tbsp oil in a pan on medium flame for 1 minute. title: besan chilla
instructions: Step 1: Mix 2 cup besan,1 tsp cumin seeds,1/2 tsp turmeric powder,and 1 tsp salt in a bowl. Add 1 cup water slowly while whisking for 2 minutes until a smooth pouring batter forms. Rest for 10 minutes. Step 2: Add 1 cup onion,1 cup tomato,2 number green chilli,and 1/4 cup coriander leaves to the batter and mix for 1 minute. Step 3: Heat a flat tawa on medium flame for 2 minutes and grease it lightly with 1 tsp oil. Step 4: Pour 1 ladle batter and spread it into a thin round chilla. Cook on medium flame for 2 minutes until the bottom turns golden and the top begins to set. Step 5: Flip carefully,drizzle a little oil,and cook for 1 more minute until both sides are cooked through. Step 6: Repeat with the remaining batter and serve hot.

instructions: Step 1: Wash 1 cup methi and chop it finely. Mix 2 cup whole wheat flour,1/2 cup besan,1 tsp cumin seeds,1 tsp chilli powder,1/2 tsp turmeric powder,and 1 tsp salt in a bowl. Step 2: Add 1 cup yogurt,2 number green chilli,1 cup chopped methi,and 1 tbsp oil. Mix well and add 1 cup water slowly while kneading for 8 minutes until a soft dough forms. Step 3: Rest the dough for 15 minutes so the flavors blend. Step 4: Divide into balls and roll each one into a thin circle. Step 5: Heat a tawa on medium flame for 2 minutes. Cook each thepla for 2 minutes on one side,flip,and cook for 2 more minutes while applying remaining oil until golden brown spots appear. Step 6: Repeat with the remaining dough and serve warm.

title: honey chilli potato
instructions: Step 1: Wash and peel 4 cup potato,then cut into thin matchstick pieces. Soak them in 4 cup water for 10 minutes and drain completely. Step 2: Mix 1 cup corn flour,1/2 cup maida,and 1 tsp salt in a bowl. Add the drained potato and toss for 2 minutes until each piece is evenly coated. Step 3: Heat 500 ml oil in a deep kadai on medium flame for 8 minutes until hot. Fry the potatoes in batches for 4 minutes until crisp and light golden. Drain on a plate for 2 minutes. Step 4: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a pan on high flame for 1 minute. Add 1 tbsp ginger,1 tbsp garlic,and 3 number green chilli. Stir for 30 seconds until aromatic. Step 5: Add 2 tbsp soy sauce,2 tbsp honey,1 tbsp vinegar,and remaining 1 tsp salt. Cook on medium flame for 1 minute until the sauce becomes glossy. Step 6: Add the fried potatoes and toss on high flame for 2 minutes until evenly coated. Step 7: Rest for 1 minute before serving hot.

title: chilli paneer
instructions: Step 1: Cut 400 g paneer into cubes. Mix 1/2 cup corn flour,1/2 cup maida,1 tsp salt,and 1 cup water into a thick batter. Coat the paneer cubes evenly in the batter and rest for 10 minutes. Step 2: Heat 500 ml oil in a deep kadai on medium flame for 8 minutes until hot. Fry the coated paneer cubes in batches for 3 minutes until light golden. Drain and keep aside. Step 3: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a wok on high flame for 1 minute. Add 1 tbsp ginger and 1 tbsp garlic,then saute for 30 seconds until aromatic. Step 4: Add 1 cup onion and 1 cup capsicum. Stir fry for 3 minutes until slightly soft but still crunchy. Step 5: Add 2 tbsp soy sauce,2 tbsp chilli sauce,and remaining 1 tsp salt. Cook for 1 minute until the sauce turns glossy. Step 6: Add the fried paneer and toss on high flame for 2 minutes until evenly coated. Step 7: Rest for 1 minute before serving hot.

title: baby corn manchurian
instructions: Step 1: Boil 400 g baby corn in 2 cup water on medium flame for 5 minutes until slightly tender. Drain and cool for 5 minutes. Step 2: Mix 1/2 cup corn flour,1/2 cup maida,1 tsp salt,and 1 cup water into a thick batter. Coat the baby corn evenly and rest for 10 minutes. Step 3: Heat 500 ml oil in a deep kadai on medium flame for 8 minutes until hot. Fry the coated baby corn in batches for 4 minutes until crisp and light golden. Drain for 2 minutes. Step 4: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a wok on high flame for 1 minute. Add 1 tbsp ginger and 1 tbsp garlic,then saute for 30 seconds until aromatic. Step 5: Add 1 cup onion and 1 cup capsicum. Stir fry for 3 minutes until slightly soft. Step 6: Add 2 tbsp soy sauce,2 tbsp chilli sauce,and remaining 1 tsp salt. Cook for 1 minute until the sauce becomes glossy. Step 7: Add the fried baby corn and toss on high flame for 2 minutes until evenly coated. Step 8: Rest for 1 minute before serving hot.

title: chicken 65
ingredients: chicken,yogurt,ginger,garlic,chilli powder,black pepper,corn flour,rice flour,curry leaves,lemon juice,oil,salt

instructions: Step 1: Wash 500 g chicken thoroughly and cut it into small pieces. Mix with 1 cup yogurt,1 tbsp ginger,1 tbsp garlic,2 tbsp chilli powder,1 tsp black pepper,and 1 tsp salt. Rest for 1 hour. Step 2: Add 1/2 cup corn flour and 1/2 cup rice flour to the marinated chicken and mix until evenly coated. Step 3: Heat 500 ml oil in a deep kadai on medium flame for 8 minutes until hot. Fry the chicken pieces in batches for 5 minutes until crisp and golden. Drain for 2 minutes. Step 4: In a pan heat 1 tbsp oil on medium flame for 1 minute. Add 1 tbsp curry leaves and fry for 20 seconds until crisp. Step 5: Add the fried chicken and 2 tbsp lemon juice,then toss on low flame for 1 minute until well coated. Step 6: Rest for 2 minutes before serving hot.

title: dahi vada
instructions: Step 1: Wash 2 cup urad dal and soak in 4 cup water for 4 hours. Drain completely and grind with 1/4 cup water for 6 minutes until fluffy and smooth. Add 1 tsp salt and beat for 2 minutes until the batter becomes airy. Step 2: Heat 500 ml oil in a deep kadai on medium flame for 8 minutes until hot. Shape the batter into small rounds and fry on medium flame for 4 minutes on each side until golden brown. Drain and cool for 5 minutes. Step 3: Soak the fried vadas in 3 cup warm water for 5 minutes until they soften,then squeeze gently to remove excess water. Step 4: Whisk 3 cup yogurt until smooth and season it with 1 tsp cumin powder and 1 tsp salt. Soak 1/4 cup tamarind in 1 cup warm water for 10 minutes,strain it,and heat with 2 tbsp jaggery on medium flame for 3 minutes until slightly thick. Step 5: Place the softened vadas in a serving dish,pour yogurt over them,add the tamarind chutney,and finish with 1 tsp chilli powder. Step 6: Chill for 10 minutes before serving.

title: tomato basil soup
instructions: Step 1: Heat 2 tbsp butter in a pan on medium flame for 1 minute. Add 1 cup onion and 1 tbsp garlic,then saute for 5 minutes until soft and light golden. Step 2: Add 4 cup tomato and 3 cup water. Cook on medium flame for 12 minutes until the tomato becomes soft and starts breaking down. Step 3: Turn off the flame and cool for 5 minutes. Blend the mixture for 2 minutes until smooth. Step 4: Pour the blended soup back into the pan and cook on low flame for 4 minutes until hot and slightly thick. Step 5: Add 1/4 cup basil,1 tsp black pepper,and 1 tsp salt. Simmer for 1 minute until aromatic. Step 6: Rest for 2 minutes before serving hot.

title: chicken clear soup
instructions: Step 1: Wash 300 g chicken thoroughly and place it in a pot with 5 cup water,1 cup onion,1 cup carrot,1 tbsp garlic,1/4 cup celery,and 1 tsp salt. Step 2: Bring to a boil on high flame for 5 minutes,then reduce to low flame and simmer for 20 minutes until the chicken is fully cooked and the broth becomes flavorful. Step 3: Remove the chicken pieces,shred them lightly,and return them to the soup. Step 4: Add 1 tsp black pepper and simmer on low flame for 3 minutes until the soup becomes aromatic. Step 5: Rest for 2 minutes before serving hot.

title: chicken burger
instructions: Step 1: Wash 400 g chicken thoroughly and mince it finely. Mix it with 1 cup onion,1 tbsp garlic,1 tsp black pepper,1 tsp salt,and 1 number egg for 2 minutes until the mixture binds well. Step 2: Shape the mixture into 4 equal patties and coat each patty with 1 cup breadcrumbs. Rest for 10 minutes so the coating sets. Step 3: Heat 500 ml oil in a deep kadai on medium flame for 8 minutes until hot. Fry the patties for 4 minutes on each side until golden brown and fully cooked. Step 4: Slice 4 number burger buns and toast them lightly on a pan for 1 minute. Step 5: Spread 1/2 cup mayonnaise on the buns,place lettuce and tomato slices,then add the fried chicken patty. Step 6: Close the burgers and serve immediately while warm.

title: paneer wrap
instructions: Step 1: Mix 2 cup maida,1 tsp salt,and 1 cup water in a bowl. Knead for 8 minutes until a soft dough forms. Cover and rest for 20 minutes. Step 2: Cut 300 g paneer into thin strips. Heat 2 tbsp oil in a pan on medium flame for 1 minute. Add 1 cup onion,1 cup capsicum,1 tbsp garlic,and 2 number green chilli. Saute for 4 minutes until slightly soft. Step 3: Add paneer,1 tsp black pepper,and 1 tsp salt. Cook on low flame for 3 minutes until the filling is dry and aromatic. Step 4: Divide the dough into balls and roll each one into a thin round wrap. Cook each wrap on a hot tawa on medium flame for 1 minute on each side until light brown spots appear. Step 5: Spread 1 tbsp yogurt over each wrap,place the paneer filling in the center,and roll tightly. Step 6: Toast the rolled wraps on a tawa for 1 minute with remaining oil until lightly crisp. Step 7: Serve hot.

title: chicken nuggets
instructions: Step 1: Wash 500 g chicken thoroughly and cut it into small pieces. Mix with 1 tbsp garlic,1 tsp black pepper,and 1 tsp salt. Rest for 15 minutes. Step 2: Beat 2 number egg in a bowl for 1 minute. In another bowl mix 1 cup maida and 1/2 cup corn flour. Step 3: Coat each chicken piece in the dry flour mixture,then dip into the beaten egg,and coat again lightly with the flour mixture. Rest for 10 minutes. Step 4: Heat 500 ml oil in a deep kadai on medium flame for 8 minutes until hot. Fry the nuggets in batches for 4 minutes until golden brown and fully cooked. Step 5: Drain for 2 minutes before serving hot.

title: masala corn

ingredient_measurements: [{"ingredient":"sweet corn","measurement":"2 cup","quantity":"","unit":"","note":""},{"ingredient":"butter","measurement":"2 tbsp","quantity":"","unit":"","note":""},{"ingredient":"chilli powder","measurement":"1 tsp","quantity":"","unit":"","note":""},{"ingredient":"black pepper","measurement":"1 tsp","quantity":"","unit":"","note":""},{"ingredient":"chaat masala","measurement":"1 tsp","quantity":"","unit":"","note":""},{"ingredient":"lemon juice","measurement":"2 tbsp","quantity":"","unit":"","note":""},{"ingredient":"salt","measurement":"1 tsp","quantity":"","unit":"","note":""}]
instructions: Step 1: Boil 2 cup sweet corn in 3 cup water on medium flame for 6 minutes until tender. Drain completely. Step 2: Heat 2 tbsp butter in a pan on low flame for 1 minute. Add the boiled corn,1 tsp chilli powder,1 tsp black pepper,1 tsp chaat masala,and 1 tsp salt. Step 3: Cook on medium flame for 2 minutes while stirring continuously until the seasoning coats the corn evenly. Step 4: Turn off the flame,add 2 tbsp lemon juice,mix for 30 seconds,and rest for 1 minute. Step 5: Serve immediately while warm.

title: onion rings
instructions: Step 1: Peel 3 number onion and cut them into thick round rings. Separate the rings carefully. Step 2: Mix 1 cup maida,1/2 cup corn flour,1 tsp black pepper,and 1 tsp salt in a bowl. Beat 1 number egg in another bowl for 1 minute. Place 1 cup breadcrumbs in a third bowl. Step 3: Coat each onion ring in the dry flour mixture,then dip into the egg,and finally coat with breadcrumbs. Rest for 10 minutes. Step 4: Heat 500 ml oil in a deep kadai on medium flame for 8 minutes until hot. Fry the rings in batches for 3 minutes on each side until golden brown and crisp. Step 5: Drain for 2 minutes before serving hot.

title: veg quesadilla
instructions: Step 1: Mix 2 cup maida,1 tsp salt,and 1 cup water in a bowl. Knead for 8 minutes until a soft dough forms. Cover and rest for 20 minutes. Step 2: Crumble 200 g paneer into a bowl and mix with 1 cup onion,1 cup capsicum,1 cup corn,1 tsp oregano,1 tsp black pepper,and 1 tsp salt. Step 3: Divide the dough into balls and roll each one into a thin round tortilla. Cook each tortilla on a hot tawa on medium flame for 1 minute on each side until light brown spots appear. Step 4: Place 2 tbsp filling and 2 tbsp cheese on one half of each tortilla and fold into a semicircle. Step 5: Heat a pan on medium flame for 1 minute with 1 tbsp oil. Cook each quesadilla for 2 minutes on each side until golden brown and the cheese melts fully. Step 6: Rest for 1 minute before serving hot.

title: alfredo pasta
instructions: Step 1: Boil 5 cup water in a large pot on high flame for 5 minutes. Add 1 tsp salt and 300 g pasta,then cook on medium flame for 10 minutes until soft but firm. Drain and keep aside. Step 2: Heat 3 tbsp butter in a pan on medium flame for 1 minute. Add 1 tbsp garlic and saute for 30 seconds until aromatic. Step 3: Add 2 tbsp maida and cook for 1 minute while stirring until the raw flour smell disappears. Step 4: Add 2 cup milk slowly while whisking continuously for 3 minutes until the sauce becomes smooth. Step 5: Add 1.5 cup cheese,1 tsp black pepper,and remaining 1 tsp salt. Cook on low flame for 2 minutes until the cheese melts completely and the sauce turns creamy. Step 6: Add the cooked pasta and toss gently on low flame for 2 minutes until evenly coated. Step 7: Rest for 2 minutes before serving hot.

title: mushroom bruschetta
instructions: Step 1: Wash 2 cup mushroom and chop them finely. Chop 1 cup tomato and 1/4 cup basil separately. Step 2: Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a pan on medium flame for 1 minute. Add 1 tbsp garlic and saute for 30 seconds until aromatic. Step 3: Add the chopped mushroom and cook on medium flame for 6 minutes until the moisture evaporates and the mushrooms turn lightly browned. Step 4: Add chopped tomato,1 tsp black pepper,and 1 tsp salt. Cook on medium flame for 3 minutes until the mixture becomes slightly thick. Step 5: Turn off the flame and add basil. Mix for 30 seconds. Step 6: Toast 4 number bread slices on a tawa for 1 minute on each side until crisp. Step 7: Top the toasted bread with the mushroom mixture and serve immediately.

title: kothu parotta
instructions: Step 1: Wash 300 g chicken thoroughly and cut it into small pieces. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a pan on medium flame for 1 minute. Add 1 cup onion,3 number green chilli,1 tbsp ginger,and 1 tbsp garlic. Saute for 5 minutes until the onion becomes soft. Step 2: Add the chicken,1 cup tomato,1 tsp garam masala,and 1 tsp salt. Cook on medium flame for 12 minutes until the chicken is fully cooked and the masala turns dry. Step 3: Beat 2 number egg with 1 tsp salt in a bowl for 1 minute. Push the chicken mixture to one side of the pan,add the egg to the empty side,and scramble on medium flame for 2 minutes until fully cooked. Step 4: Tear 4 number parotta into small pieces and add them to the pan with 1/4 cup coriander leaves and 1/2 cup water. Step 5: Chop and mix everything on high flame for 3 minutes until the parotta pieces are coated well and the dish becomes slightly moist but not wet. Step 6: Rest for 2 minutes before serving hot.

title: chicken lollipop

instructions: Step 1: Wash 500 g chicken thoroughly and separate the lollipop pieces if already cut. Mix with 1 cup yogurt,1 tbsp ginger,1 tbsp garlic,2 tsp chilli powder,1 tsp black pepper,and 1 tsp salt. Rest for 30 minutes. Step 2: Beat 1 number egg in a bowl for 1 minute. In another bowl mix 1/2 cup corn flour and 1/2 cup maida. Step 3: Coat each chicken piece in the dry flour mixture,then dip in the beaten egg,and coat again lightly with the flour mixture. Step 4: Heat 500 ml oil in a deep kadai on medium flame for 8 minutes until hot. Fry the chicken pieces in batches for 5 minutes until golden brown and crisp outside and fully cooked inside. Step 5: Drain for 2 minutes before serving hot.

title: fish cakes
instructions: Step 1: Wash 400 g fish thoroughly and cook it in 2 cup water with 1 tsp salt on medium flame for 10 minutes until fully cooked. Cool for 5 minutes and flake it finely,removing any bones. Step 2: Boil 2 cup potato in 3 cup water on medium flame for 15 minutes until soft. Peel and mash completely. Step 3: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a pan on medium flame for 1 minute. Add 1 cup onion,1 tbsp ginger,and 1 tbsp garlic. Saute for 4 minutes until soft. Step 4: Mix the flaked fish,mashed potato,sauteed onion mixture,1/4 cup coriander leaves,1 number egg,1 tsp black pepper,and 1 tsp salt in a bowl for 2 minutes until the mixture binds well. Step 5: Shape into small cakes and coat each one with 2 cup breadcrumbs. Rest for 10 minutes. Step 6: Heat 500 ml oil in a deep kadai on medium flame for 8 minutes until hot. Fry the cakes for 4 minutes on each side until golden brown and crisp. Step 7: Drain for 2 minutes before serving hot.

title: cheese corn samosa
instructions: Step 1: Mix 3 cup maida,1 tsp salt,and 2 tbsp oil in a bowl. Add 1 cup water slowly and knead for 8 minutes until a firm dough forms. Cover and rest for 20 minutes. Step 2: Boil 1 cup sweet corn in 2 cup water on medium flame for 5 minutes until tender. Drain completely. Step 3: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a pan on medium flame for 1 minute. Add 1 cup onion and 2 number green chilli. Saute for 4 minutes until soft. Step 4: Add the boiled corn,1 cup cheese,and 1/4 cup coriander leaves. Cook on low flame for 2 minutes until the cheese begins to melt and the filling becomes cohesive. Cool for 5 minutes. Step 5: Roll the dough into thin circles and cut each circle into halves. Shape each half into a cone,fill with 2 tbsp filling,and seal the edges with a little water. Step 6: Heat 500 ml oil in a deep kadai on medium flame for 8 minutes until hot. Fry the samosas on low-medium flame for 6 minutes until deep golden brown and crisp. Step 7: Drain for 2 minutes before serving hot.

title: potato smiley
instructions: Step 1: Boil 3 cup potato in 3 cup water on medium flame for 15 minutes until soft. Peel and mash completely. Step 2: Mix the mashed potato with 1/2 cup corn flour,1/4 cup maida,1 tsp chilli powder,1 tsp black pepper,and 1 tsp salt in a bowl for 2 minutes until a firm dough forms. Rest for 10 minutes. Step 3: Roll the mixture into a 1 cm thick sheet and cut smiley shapes using a cutter or a small knife. Step 4: Heat 500 ml oil in a deep kadai on medium flame for 8 minutes until hot. Fry the smileys in batches for 3 minutes on each side until golden brown and crisp. Step 5: Drain for 2 minutes before serving hot.

title: chicken pakora
instructions: Step 1: Wash 400 g chicken thoroughly and cut into small bite-sized pieces. Mix with 1 cup yogurt,1 tbsp ginger,1 tbsp garlic,2 tsp chilli powder,and 1 tsp salt. Rest for 20 minutes. Step 2: Add 1 cup besan and 1/2 cup rice flour to the marinated chicken. Mix well until every piece is coated evenly. Step 3: Add 1 tbsp curry leaves and mix for 1 minute. Step 4: Heat 500 ml oil in a deep kadai on medium flame for 8 minutes until hot. Drop the coated chicken pieces into the oil and fry in batches for 5 minutes until golden brown and crisp. Step 5: Drain for 2 minutes before serving hot.

title: garlic mushroom
instructions: Step 1: Wash 400 g mushroom thoroughly and slice evenly. Step 2: Heat 3 tbsp butter in a pan on medium flame for 1 minute. Add 3 tbsp garlic and saute for 30 seconds until aromatic. Step 3: Add the sliced mushroom and cook on medium flame for 6 minutes until the moisture releases and starts evaporating. Step 4: Add 1 tsp black pepper,1 tsp oregano,and 1 tsp salt. Cook on low flame for 3 minutes until the mushroom becomes lightly browned and dry. Step 5: Rest for 2 minutes before serving hot.

title: masala toast
instructions: Step 1: Finely chop 1 cup onion,1 cup tomato,and 1 cup capsicum. Mix them in a bowl with 1 tsp chilli powder,1 tsp black pepper,and 1 tsp salt. Step 2: Heat a tawa on medium flame for 2 minutes and apply 1 tbsp butter. Step 3: Place 6 number bread slices on the tawa. Spread the vegetable mixture evenly on top of each slice. Step 4: Cook on medium flame for 3 minutes until the bottom becomes golden and the topping begins to soften. Step 5: Add remaining butter in small portions,cover the pan,and cook on low flame for 2 minutes until the vegetables are hot and the bread is crisp. Step 6: Rest for 1 minute before serving hot.

title: methi mathri
instructions: Step 1: Wash 1 cup methi and chop it finely. Mix 3 cup maida,1 tsp ajwain,and 1 tsp salt in a bowl. Add 3 tbsp ghee and rub it into the flour for 3 minutes until the mixture becomes crumbly. Step 2: Add the chopped methi and 1 cup water slowly,then knead for 8 minutes until a firm dough forms. Rest for 20 minutes. Step 3: Divide the dough into small balls and flatten each one into a round disc. Prick each disc lightly with a fork so it stays crisp while frying. Step 4: Heat 500 ml oil in a deep kadai on medium flame for 8 minutes until hot. Fry the mathri on low-medium flame for 5 minutes on each side until deep golden brown and crisp. Step 5: Drain for 2 minutes and cool completely before serving.

title: bread pakora
instructions: Step 1: Boil 2 cup potato in 3 cup water on medium flame for 15 minutes until soft. Peel and mash completely. Step 2: Mix the mashed potato with 1 cup onion,2 number green chilli,1 tbsp ginger,1/4 cup coriander leaves,1 tsp chilli powder,and 1 tsp salt in a bowl for 2 minutes until a thick filling forms. Step 3: Spread 2 tbsp filling between two bread slices to form a sandwich and press lightly. Repeat for all 6 number bread slices. Step 4: Mix 1 cup besan,1/2 cup rice flour,1 tsp salt,and 1 cup water in a bowl until smooth and thick. Step 5: Heat 500 ml oil in a deep kadai on medium flame for 8 minutes until hot. Dip each bread sandwich into the batter and fry for 3 minutes on each side until golden brown and crisp. Step 6: Drain for 2 minutes before serving hot.

title: dahi puri
instructions: Step 1: Boil 1 cup potato in 2 cup water on medium flame for 15 minutes until soft. Peel and mash it lightly. Step 2: Soak 1 cup chickpeas in 4 cup water for 8 hours,then pressure cook with 2 cup fresh water and 1 tsp salt on high flame for 1 whistle and on low flame for 15 minutes until soft. Drain and cool for 5 minutes. Step 3: Whisk 2 cup yogurt in a bowl for 1 minute until smooth. Add 1 tsp salt and 1 tsp cumin powder,then mix for 30 seconds until evenly combined. Step 4: Arrange 12 number puri on a plate and crack the tops gently with your fingers. Fill each puri with 1 tsp mashed potato and 1 tsp chickpeas. Step 5: Add 1 tsp yogurt mixture,1 tsp tamarind chutney,and 1 tsp mint chutney into each puri. Sprinkle 1 cup sev and 1 tsp chaat masala over the top. Step 6: Serve immediately while crisp.

title: sev puri
instructions: Step 1: Boil 1 cup potato in 2 cup water on medium flame for 15 minutes until soft. Peel and mash lightly. Step 2: Finely chop 1 cup tomato and 1 cup onion into small pieces. Mix them with 1 tsp salt and 1 tsp cumin powder in a bowl for 1 minute. Step 3: Arrange 12 number puri on a plate and crack the tops gently with your fingers. Fill each puri with 1 tsp mashed potato and 1 tsp onion tomato mixture. Step 4: Add 1 tsp tamarind chutney and 1 tsp mint chutney into each puri. Step 5: Sprinkle 1 cup sev and 1 tsp chaat masala evenly over the top. Step 6: Serve immediately while crisp.

Add 1 tsp cumin seeds and cook for 30 seconds until they crackle. Add 1 cup onion,2 number green chilli,1 tbsp ginger,and 1 tbsp garlic. Saute for 5 minutes until the onion softens. Step 3: Add 1 cup tomato and cook on medium flame for 6 minutes until soft and pulpy. Step 4: Add 1 cup yogurt,1 tbsp coriander powder,1 tsp chilli powder,1 tsp garam masala,and 2 tsp salt. Cook on low flame for 4 minutes until the masala looks glossy and the yogurt blends smoothly. Step 5: Add the remaining 1 cup onion and cook on medium flame for 3 minutes so the onion stays slightly crunchy. Step 6: Add the paneer cubes and 3 cup water,then simmer on low flame for 5 minutes until the gravy thickens slightly. Step 7: Rest for 3 minutes before serving hot.

title: mushroom tikka
instructions: Step 1: Wash 500 g mushroom thoroughly and dry them completely. Step 2: Mix 1 cup yogurt,2 tbsp besan,1 tbsp ginger,1 tbsp garlic,2 tsp chilli powder,1 tsp garam masala,2 tbsp lemon juice,1 tsp salt,and 2 tbsp oil in a bowl for 2 minutes until smooth. Step 3: Add the mushrooms into the marinade and coat evenly. Rest for 30 minutes. Step 4: Thread the marinated mushrooms onto skewers or place them on a greased baking tray. Step 5: Bake in a preheated oven on medium heat for 15 minutes,turn once halfway,and cook until the mushrooms are lightly charred and tender. Step 6: Rest for 3 minutes before serving hot.

title: french fries
instructions: Step 1: Wash and peel 4 cup potato,then cut them into long even sticks. Soak in 4 cup water for 15 minutes to remove excess starch and drain completely. Step 2: Heat 500 ml oil in a deep kadai on medium flame for 8 minutes until hot. Fry the potato sticks in batches for 4 minutes until pale golden and partly cooked. Remove and rest for 5 minutes. Step 3: Fry the potatoes again on high flame for 2 minutes until crisp and deep golden brown. Step 4: Drain for 2 minutes and sprinkle 1 tsp salt evenly while hot. Step 5: Serve immediately.

title: pasta salad
instructions: Step 1: Boil 5 cup water in a large pot on high flame for 5 minutes. Add 1 tsp salt and 2 cup pasta,then cook on medium flame for 10 minutes until soft but firm. Drain and cool for 10 minutes. Step 2: Chop 1 cup cucumber,1 cup tomato,and 1 cup onion into small pieces. Step 3: Mix 2 tbsp olive oil,2 tbsp lemon juice,1 tsp black pepper,and 1 tsp salt in a large bowl for 30 seconds until combined. Step 4: Add the cooled pasta,vegetables,and 1/4 cup parsley. Toss gently for 1 minute until evenly coated. Step 5: Chill for 10 minutes before serving cold or at room temperature.

title: chole bhature
instructions: Step 1: Soak 2 cup chickpeas in 6 cup water for 8 hours. Drain and pressure cook with 4 cup water and 1 tsp salt on high flame for 1 whistle,then on low flame for 20 minutes until soft. Step 2: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a pan on medium flame for 1 minute. Add 2 cup onion,2 number green chilli,1 tbsp ginger,and 1 tbsp garlic. Saute for 6 minutes until soft. Add 1 cup tomato and cook on medium flame for 6 minutes until the tomato breaks down. Add 2 tbsp chole masala and 2 tsp salt,then cook for 2 minutes. Add the cooked chickpeas and simmer on low flame for 10 minutes until the gravy thickens. Step 3: Mix 3 cup maida,1 cup yogurt,2 tbsp semolina,and 1 cup water into a soft dough. Knead for 10 minutes and rest for 2 hours until puffy. Step 4: Divide into balls and roll into thick discs. Step 5: Heat 500 ml oil in a deep kadai on medium flame for 8 minutes until hot. Fry each bhatura for 1 minute on one side and 1 minute on the other side until puffed and golden. Step 6: Serve the bhature hot with chole.

title: banana crepe
instructions: Step 1: Mash 2 number banana in a bowl until smooth. Add 1 number egg,1 cup milk,2 tbsp sugar,1 tsp vanilla essence,1 cup maida,and 0.25 tsp salt. Whisk for 2 minutes until a smooth batter forms. Step 2: Rest the batter for 10 minutes so it becomes even and slightly thick. Step 3: Heat a nonstick pan on medium flame for 2 minutes and add 1 tsp butter. Pour a thin layer of batter and swirl the pan gently to spread it. Step 4: Cook for 2 minutes until the edges turn light golden and the top looks set. Flip carefully and cook for 1 minute on the other side until lightly browned. Step 5: Repeat with the remaining batter and serve warm.

title: vada pav
ingredients: potato,pav,besan,maida,onion,green chilli,ginger,garlic,curry leaves,mustard seeds,turmeric powder,chilli powder,coriander leaves,green chutney,tamarind chutney,salt,oil,water

Cook on low flame for 4 minutes until the filling becomes dry and well mixed. Cool for 10 minutes and shape into 4 equal balls. Step 4: Mix 1 cup besan,1/2 cup maida,1 tsp salt,and 1 cup water into a smooth thick batter. Step 5: Heat 500 ml oil in a deep kadai on medium flame for 8 minutes until hot.
