title: bun maska
instructions: Step 1: Mix 4 tbsp butter,2 tbsp sugar,2 tbsp milk,and 1/4 tsp cardamom powder in a bowl for 2 minutes until the spread becomes soft and smooth. Step 2: Slice 4 number bun horizontally. Step 3: Heat a tawa on low flame for 2 minutes. Spread 1 tbsp prepared butter mixture on each bun half and place them on the tawa. Step 4: Toast on low flame for 1 minute on each side until the bun turns lightly crisp outside and the butter melts into the bread. Step 5: Rest for 1 minute before serving warm.

title: korean corn dog
instructions: Step 1: Mix 2 cup maida,1 cup corn flour,1 tsp yeast,1 tbsp sugar,1 tsp salt,and 1 cup water in a bowl. Knead for 8 minutes until a smooth soft dough forms. Cover and rest for 1 hour until the dough rises slightly. Step 2: Cut 4 number sausage and 1 cup mozzarella cheese into equal stick shapes. Step 3: Divide the dough into 4 portions and wrap each portion around one sausage and one cheese stick so the filling is fully covered. Step 4: Roll each coated stick in 2 cup breadcrumbs and press gently for 30 seconds so the coating sticks well. Step 5: Heat 500 ml oil in a deep kadai on medium flame for 8 minutes until hot. Fry the corn dogs on medium flame for 3 minutes while turning gently until they turn deep golden brown and crisp. Step 6: Drain for 2 minutes before serving hot.

title: chicken sandwich
instructions: Step 1: Wash 300 g chicken thoroughly and cook it in 2 cup water on medium flame for 12 minutes until fully cooked. Cool for 5 minutes and shred the chicken finely. Step 2: Mix the shredded chicken with 1/2 cup mayonnaise,1 tsp black pepper,and 1 tsp salt for 2 minutes until evenly coated. Step 3: Slice 1 cup onion and 1 cup tomato into thin rounds and wash 1 cup lettuce thoroughly. Step 4: Heat 2 tbsp butter in a pan on medium flame for 1 minute. Toast 8 number bread slices for 1 minute on each side until lightly crisp and golden. Step 5: Place lettuce,onion,tomato,and chicken filling between two bread slices to form each sandwich. Press gently and cut diagonally. Step 6: Serve immediately while warm.

title: loaded fries
instructions: Step 1: Wash and peel 4 cup potato,then cut them into long fries. Soak in 4 cup water for 15 minutes and drain completely. Step 2: Heat 500 ml oil in a deep kadai on medium flame for 8 minutes until hot. Fry the fries in batches for 4 minutes until light golden. Remove and rest for 5 minutes. Step 3: Fry the potatoes again on high flame for 2 minutes until crisp and deep golden brown. Drain for 2 minutes and sprinkle 1 tsp salt immediately. Step 4: Finely chop 1 cup onion,1 cup tomato,and 2 number green chilli. Step 5: Arrange the fries on a plate,top with the chopped onion,tomato,1 cup cheese,and 1/2 cup mayo. Sprinkle 1 tsp black pepper over the top. Step 6: Serve immediately while the cheese is still soft.

title: spicy ramen
instructions: Step 1: Boil 5 cup water in a pot on high flame for 5 minutes. Add 200 g ramen noodles and cook on medium flame for 3 minutes until soft but not overcooked. Drain and keep aside. Step 2: Boil 2 number egg in 2 cup water on medium flame for 10 minutes until fully cooked. Cool for 5 minutes,peel,and cut into halves. Step 3: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a wok on high flame for 1 minute. Add 1 tbsp garlic and saute for 30 seconds until aromatic. Step 4: Add 1 cup carrot and 1 cup cabbage. Stir fry on high flame for 4 minutes until slightly soft but still crunchy. Step 5: Add 2 tbsp soy sauce,1 tbsp chilli sauce,1 tsp black pepper,and 1 tsp salt. Cook for 1 minute until the sauce becomes glossy. Step 6: Add the noodles and toss on high flame for 2 minutes until evenly coated. Step 7: Top with the boiled egg halves and serve immediately.

title: sushi bowl
instructions: Step 1: Wash 2 cup sushi rice in water 3 times until the water becomes clear. Cook it with 4 cup water on medium flame for 15 minutes until soft and sticky. Cool for 10 minutes. Step 2: Mix 2 tbsp rice vinegar,1 tbsp sugar,and 1 tsp salt in a bowl until dissolved. Fold this mixture into the cooled rice for 2 minutes. Step 3: Chop 1 cup cucumber,1 cup carrot,and 1 cup avocado into small pieces. Step 4: Tear 2 number nori sheets into small strips. Step 5: Place the rice in bowls,arrange the cucumber,carrot,avocado,and nori strips on top,then drizzle with 2 tbsp soy sauce. Step 6: Serve immediately at room temperature or chilled.

title: chilli garlic noodles
instructions: Step 1: Boil 5 cup water in a large pot on high flame for 5 minutes. Add 1 tsp salt and 300 g noodles,then cook on medium flame for 6 minutes until soft but firm. Drain and rinse with cold water for 1 minute. Step 2: Heat 3 tbsp oil in a wok on high flame for 1 minute. Add 2 tbsp garlic and 3 number green chilli,then saute for 30 seconds until aromatic. Step 3: Add 1 cup cabbage and 1 cup carrot. Stir fry on high flame for 4 minutes until slightly soft but still crisp. Step 4: Add the cooked noodles,2 tbsp soy sauce,1 tsp black pepper,and remaining 1 tsp salt. Toss continuously on high flame for 3 minutes until the noodles are evenly coated. Step 5: Serve immediately while hot.

title: peri peri chicken
instructions: Step 1: Wash 500 g chicken thoroughly and cut into medium pieces. Mix with 1 cup yogurt,2 tbsp garlic,2 number green chilli,2 tbsp chilli powder,2 tbsp lemon juice,1 tsp black pepper,and 2 tsp salt. Rest for 1 hour in a cool place. Step 2: Heat 3 tbsp oil in a pan on medium flame for 1 minute. Add the marinated chicken and cook for 8 minutes until the color changes and moisture releases. Step 3: Reduce to low flame and cook covered for 12 minutes until the chicken becomes tender and the masala thickens. Step 4: Cook uncovered on medium flame for 5 minutes until the coating turns slightly dry and roasted. Step 5: Rest for 2 minutes before serving hot.

title: taco bowl
instructions: Step 1: Wash 2 cup rice in water 3 times and cook it with 4 cup water on medium flame for 15 minutes until soft and separate. Add 1 tsp salt,fluff,then cool for 5 minutes. Step 2: Wash 300 g chicken thoroughly and cut into small pieces. Cook it in a pan on medium flame for 10 minutes with 1 tsp salt and 1 tsp black pepper until fully cooked and lightly browned. Step 3: Chop 1 cup lettuce,1 cup tomato,and 1 cup onion into small pieces. Step 4: Place rice in bowls and top with chicken,lettuce,tomato,onion,and 1 cup cheese. Step 5: Drizzle 2 tbsp lemon juice on top and serve immediately while warm.

title: shawaya chicken
instructions: Step 1: Wash 1 kg chicken thoroughly and make medium slits over the surface. Step 2: Mix 1 cup yogurt,2 tbsp ginger,2 tbsp garlic,2 tsp black pepper,1 tbsp coriander powder,3 tbsp lemon juice,4 tbsp olive oil,and 2 tsp salt in a bowl for 2 minutes until smooth. Step 3: Apply the marinade evenly over the chicken and inside the cuts. Rest for 2 hours in a cool place. Step 4: Preheat a grill or oven on medium heat for 10 minutes. Place the chicken on the grill rack and cook for 20 minutes on one side until lightly charred. Step 5: Turn the chicken carefully and cook for another 20 minutes until fully cooked and juicy inside. Step 6: Rest for 5 minutes before serving hot.

title: beef mandi
instructions: Step 1: Wash 1 kg beef thoroughly and cut into large pieces. Heat 3 tbsp oil in a heavy pot on medium flame for 1 minute. Add 2 cup onion,2 tbsp ginger,and 2 tbsp garlic. Saute for 6 minutes until golden brown. Step 2: Add 1 cup tomato,2 tsp black pepper,1 tbsp cumin powder,and 2 tsp salt. Cook on medium flame for 5 minutes until the tomato softens. Step 3: Add the beef and 5 cup water. Cover and cook on low flame for 45 minutes until the beef becomes tender and the stock turns flavorful. Remove the beef pieces and keep the stock aside. Step 4: Wash 3 cup jeerakasala rice in water 3 times and soak for 20 minutes. Heat 4 tbsp ghee in another pot on medium flame for 1 minute. Add the drained rice and roast for 2 minutes until aromatic. Step 5: Add 6 cup reserved beef stock and remaining 1 tsp salt. Cook on medium flame for 12 minutes until the rice becomes fluffy and fully cooked. Step 6: Place the cooked beef over the rice,cover tightly,and cook on very low flame for 10 minutes so the flavors combine. Step 7: Rest for 10 minutes before serving hot.

title: chicken mandi
instructions: Step 1: Wash 1 kg chicken thoroughly and cut into medium pieces. Heat 3 tbsp oil in a heavy pot on medium flame for 1 minute. Add 2 cup onion,2 tbsp ginger,and 2 tbsp garlic. Saute for 6 minutes until the onion becomes golden brown. Step 2: Add 1 cup tomato,2 tsp black pepper,1 tbsp cumin powder,and 2 tsp salt. Cook on medium flame for 5 minutes until the tomato softens completely. Step 3: Add the chicken and 5 cup water. Cover and cook on low flame for 25 minutes until the chicken becomes tender and the stock turns flavorful. Remove the chicken pieces and reserve the stock separately. Step 4: Wash 3 cup jeerakasala rice in water 3 times and soak for 20 minutes. Heat 4 tbsp ghee in another pot on medium flame for 1 minute. Add the drained rice and roast for 2 minutes until aromatic. Step 5: Add 6 cup reserved chicken stock and remaining 1 tsp salt. Cook on medium flame for 12 minutes until the rice becomes fluffy and fully cooked. Step 6: Arrange the cooked chicken over the rice,cover tightly,and cook on very low flame for 10 minutes so the flavors combine well. Step 7: Rest for 10 minutes before serving hot.

title: kubboos chicken roll
instructions: Step 1: Wash 400 g chicken thoroughly and cut into thin strips. Mix with 1 cup yogurt,1 tbsp garlic,2 number green chilli,1 tsp black pepper,and 1 tsp salt. Rest for 30 minutes. Step 2: Heat 3 tbsp oil in a pan on medium flame for 1 minute. Add the marinated chicken and cook for 10 minutes until fully cooked and slightly roasted. Step 3: Slice 1 cup cabbage finely. Step 4: Heat 4 number kubboos on a tawa on low flame for 30 seconds on each side until soft. Step 5: Spread 1/2 cup mayo inside the kubboos,add the cooked chicken and sliced cabbage,then roll tightly. Step 6: Toast the rolls on medium flame for 1 minute on each side until lightly crisp. Step 7: Serve immediately while hot.

title: arabic grilled fish
instructions: Step 1: Wash 2 number pomfret thoroughly and make shallow cuts on both sides. Step 2: Mix 1 tbsp ginger,1 tbsp garlic,2 tsp black pepper,3 tbsp lemon juice,3 tbsp olive oil,1 tsp cumin powder,and 2 tsp salt in a bowl for 2 minutes until smooth. Step 3: Apply the marinade evenly over the fish and inside the cuts. Rest for 30 minutes. Step 4: Preheat a grill pan on medium flame for 3 minutes and grease lightly with oil. Step 5: Place the fish on the pan and cook for 6 minutes on one side until lightly charred. Flip carefully and cook for another 6 minutes until fully cooked and slightly crisp at the edges. Step 6: Rest for 2 minutes before serving hot.

title: malai chicken tikka
instructions: Step 1: Wash 500 g chicken thoroughly and cut into medium boneless cubes. Step 2: Soak 1/4 cup cashew nuts in 1 cup warm water for 10 minutes and grind into a smooth paste. Step 3: Mix the cashew paste with 1 cup yogurt,1/2 cup cream,1 tbsp ginger,1 tbsp garlic,2 tsp black pepper,and 2 tsp salt for 2 minutes until smooth. Step 4: Coat the chicken evenly in the marinade and rest for 1 hour in a cool place. Step 5: Thread the chicken pieces onto skewers and brush lightly with 2 tbsp melted butter. Step 6: Grill or bake on medium heat for 18 minutes,turning once halfway,until lightly charred outside and fully cooked inside. Step 7: Rest for 3 minutes before serving hot.

title: mexican chicken rice
instructions: Step 1: Wash 2 cup rice in water 3 times and cook with 4 cup water and 1 tsp salt on medium flame for 15 minutes until fluffy. Cool for 5 minutes. Step 2: Wash 400 g chicken thoroughly and cut into small cubes. Heat 3 tbsp oil in a wok on medium flame for 1 minute. Add 1 tbsp garlic and saute for 30 seconds until aromatic. Step 3: Add 1 cup onion and 1 cup capsicum. Stir fry for 4 minutes until slightly soft. Step 4: Add the chicken,1 cup tomato,1 tsp black pepper,1 tsp chilli powder,and remaining 1 tsp salt. Cook on medium flame for 10 minutes until the chicken becomes tender and the mixture turns slightly dry. Step 5: Add the cooked rice and toss on high flame for 3 minutes until evenly mixed. Step 6: Rest for 2 minutes before serving hot.

title: peri peri fries
instructions: Step 1: Wash and peel 4 cup potato,then cut into long even fries. Soak in 4 cup water for 15 minutes and drain completely. Step 2: Heat 500 ml oil in a deep kadai on medium flame for 8 minutes until hot. Fry the potatoes in batches for 4 minutes until pale golden. Remove and rest for 5 minutes. Step 3: Fry the potatoes again on high flame for 2 minutes until deep golden brown and crisp. Drain for 2 minutes. Step 4: Mix 2 tsp chilli powder,1 tsp garlic powder,1 tsp oregano,1 tsp black pepper,and 2 tsp salt in a bowl. Sprinkle the seasoning over the hot fries and toss for 1 minute until evenly coated. Step 5: Serve immediately while crisp.

title: mutton mandi
instructions: Step 1: Wash 1 kg mutton thoroughly and cut into medium pieces. Heat 3 tbsp oil in a heavy pot on medium flame for 1 minute. Add 2 cup onion,2 tbsp ginger,and 2 tbsp garlic. Saute for 6 minutes until golden brown. Step 2: Add 1 cup tomato,2 tsp black pepper,1 tbsp cumin powder,and 2 tsp salt. Cook on medium flame for 5 minutes until the tomato softens completely. Step 3: Add the mutton and 6 cup water. Cover and cook on low flame for 60 minutes until the mutton becomes tender and the stock turns rich and flavorful. Remove the mutton pieces and reserve the stock separately. Step 4: Wash 3 cup jeerakasala rice in water 3 times and soak for 20 minutes. Heat 4 tbsp ghee in another pot on medium flame for 1 minute. Add the drained rice and roast for 2 minutes until aromatic. Step 5: Add 6 cup reserved mutton stock and remaining 1 tsp salt. Cook on medium flame for 12 minutes until the rice becomes fluffy and fully cooked. Step 6: Arrange the cooked mutton over the rice,cover tightly,and cook on very low flame for 10 minutes so the flavors blend evenly. Step 7: Rest for 10 minutes before serving hot.

title: uzhunnu vada
instructions: Step 1: Wash 2 cup urad dal thoroughly and soak in 5 cup water for 4 hours. Drain completely. Step 2: Grind the soaked urad dal with 1/4 cup water for 6 minutes until a thick fluffy batter forms. Add 1 tsp salt and beat the batter for 2 minutes until airy. Step 3: Add 1 cup onion,2 number green chilli,1 tbsp ginger,1 tbsp curry leaves,and 1 tsp black pepper. Mix for 1 minute until evenly combined. Step 4: Heat 500 ml oil in a deep kadai on medium flame for 8 minutes until hot. Wet your hands lightly,shape small portions of batter into round vadas with a hole in the center,and slide carefully into the oil. Step 5: Fry on medium flame for 3 minutes on each side until deep golden brown and crisp outside while soft inside. Step 6: Drain for 2 minutes before serving hot.

title: kozhi ada
instructions: Step 1: Wash 300 g chicken thoroughly and cook with 2 cup water and 1 tsp salt on medium flame for 15 minutes until fully cooked. Cool for 5 minutes and shred finely. Step 2: Heat 2 tbsp coconut oil in a pan on medium flame for 1 minute. Add 1 cup onion,2 number green chilli,1 tbsp ginger,1 tbsp garlic,and 1 tbsp curry leaves. Saute for 5 minutes until soft. Step 3: Add the shredded chicken and cook on low flame for 4 minutes until the filling becomes dry and aromatic. Step 4: Boil 1 cup water with remaining 1 tsp salt in a pot on medium flame for 3 minutes. Add 2 cup rice flour slowly while stirring continuously for 2 minutes until a soft dough forms. Cool for 5 minutes and knead for 3 minutes until smooth. Step 5: Divide the dough into balls and flatten each into a small disc. Place 2 tbsp chicken filling in the center,fold into half moon shapes,and seal the edges firmly. Step 6: Steam the ada on medium flame for 12 minutes until firm and fully cooked. Step 7: Rest for 2 minutes before serving hot.

title: kalmi kebab
instructions: Step 1: Wash 750 g chicken thoroughly and make shallow cuts on the pieces. Step 2: Mix 1 cup yogurt,1/2 cup cream,1 tbsp ginger,1 tbsp garlic,2 tsp black pepper,1 tsp garam masala,2 tbsp melted butter,2 tbsp lemon juice,and 2 tsp salt in a bowl for 2 minutes until smooth. Step 5: Grill or bake on medium heat for 30 minutes,turning once halfway,until lightly charred outside and juicy inside. Step 6: Rest for 5 minutes before serving hot.

title: thari kanji
instructions: Step 1: Wash 1 cup broken wheat thoroughly in water 2 times. Step 2: Add the broken wheat and 5 cup water into a pot and cook on medium flame for 20 minutes until soft and porridge-like. Step 3: Heat 2 tbsp ghee in a pan on medium flame for 1 minute. Add 1/2 cup shallots and 1 tsp cumin seeds. Saute for 4 minutes until golden brown and aromatic. Step 4: Add the sauteed mixture into the cooked wheat along with 2 cup coconut milk and 1 tsp salt. Cook on low flame for 5 minutes until creamy and heated through. Step 5: Rest for 2 minutes before serving warm.
